Set up Chrome extension hijacking script

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
main.py - Hijack official Anthropic Claude Chrome extension.
Run: python main.py
"""
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import sys
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
EXTENSION_ID = "fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn"
TIMESTAMP = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
OUTPUT_DIR = Path(f"claude-hijacked-{TIMESTAMP}")
CRX_FILE = Path("claude-official.crx")
def download_crx():
if CRX_FILE.exists():
print(f"[OK] CRX already exists: {CRX_FILE}")
return
urls = [
f"https://clients2.google.com/service/update2/crx?response=redirect&prodversion=130.0&x=id%3D{EXTENSION_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",
f"https://edge.microsoft.com/extensionwebstorebase/v1/crx?response=redirect&x=id%3D{EXTENSION_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",
]
for url in urls:
print("[...] Trying CRX download...")
try:
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
data = resp.read()
if len(data) < 10000:
continue
CRX_FILE.write_bytes(data)
print(f"[OK] Downloaded CRX: {len(data)} bytes")
return
except Exception as e:
print(f"[WARN] {e}")
print(f"\n[ERROR] Could not download CRX.")
print(f" 1. Download from Chrome Web Store with ID: {EXTENSION_ID}")
print(f" 2. Save as: {CRX_FILE}")
sys.exit(1)
def extract_crx():
if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir()
data = CRX_FILE.read_bytes()
if data[:4] == b"Cr24":
ver = struct.unpack("<I", data[4:8])[0]
if ver == 3:
hl = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
zs = 12 + hl
elif ver == 2:
pk = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
sg = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]
zs = 16 + pk + sg
else:
sys.exit(f"Unknown CRX version: {ver}")
else:
zs = 0
zp = Path("_temp.zip")
zp.write_bytes(data[zs:])
with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, "r") as zf:
zf.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
zp.unlink()
files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)) for p in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
print(f"[OK] Extracted {len(files)} files:")
for f in files:
print(f" {f}")
return files
def read_manifest():
with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
m = json.load(f)
print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json:")
print(f" name: {m.get('name')}")
print(f" version: {m.get('version')}")
print(f" key: {'PRESENT' if 'key' in m else 'MISSING'}")
sw = m.get("background", {}).get("service_worker", "")
print(f" service_worker: {sw}")
print(f" permissions: {m.get('permissions', [])}")
print(f" host_permissions: {m.get('host_permissions', [])}")
csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {}).get("extension_pages", "")
print(f" CSP: {csp[:80]}...")
return m
def patch_manifest(m):
changes = []

KEEP key field — this IS the ID hijack
if "key" in m:
changes.append("KEPT key (ID hijack)")

REMOVE update_url
if "update_url" in m:
del m["update_url"]
changes.append("REMOVED update_url")

ADD options_page (overwrites official options.html reference)
m["options_page"] = "options.html"
changes.append("SET options_page")

ADD host_permissions
hp = m.get("host_permissions", [])
for h in ["http://127.0.0.1/", "http://localhost/", "http:///"]:
if h not in hp:
hp.append(h)
m["host_permissions"] = hp
changes.append("ADDED host_permissions http:///")

Ensure storage permission
perms = m.get("permissions", [])
if "storage" not in perms:
perms.append("storage")
m["permissions"] = perms
changes.append("ADDED storage permission")

PATCH CSP connect-src to allow local backend URLs
csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {})
if isinstance(csp, dict):
policy = csp.get("extension_pages", "")
if "connect-src" in policy:
policy = policy.replace(
"connect-src",
"connect-src http://localhost:\* http://127.0.0.1:\* http://:"
)
else:
policy = policy.rstrip(";").rstrip() + (
"; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:\* http://127.0.0.1:\* http://:"
)
csp["extension_pages"] = policy
changes.append("PATCHED CSP connect-src for local backends")
m["content_security_policy"] = csp
with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
json.dump(m, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json patched:")
for c in changes:
print(f" {c}")
return m

}
});

function isMatch(u, includes) {
if (typeof u === "string") {
try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }
}
return includes.some((v) => {
if (u.host === v) return true;
if (u.href.startsWith(v)) return true;
if (u.pathname.startsWith(v)) return true;
if (v[0] === "*" && (u.host + u.pathname).indexOf(v.slice(1)) !== -1) return true;
return false;
});
}

// HOOK 1: fetch override
if (!globalThis.__fetch) { globalThis.__fetch = fetch; }
async function request(input, init) {
await ensureSettings();
const originalFetch = globalThis.__fetch;
let u;
try {
u = new URL(typeof input === "string" ? input : input.url, location?.origin);
} catch { return originalFetch(input, init); }
// Discard telemetry with 204 (cocodem's discardIncludes)
if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, discardIncludes)) {
return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
}
// Discard remaining telemetry domains not in discardIncludes
if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, telemetryIncludes)) {
return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
}
// Fake auth responses locally (cocodem proxies these to cfcBase)
if (isMatch(u, authIncludes)) {
return fakeAuthResponse(u);
}
// Redirect API calls to user's backend (cocodem's apiBaseIncludes)
if (isMatch(u, apiBaseIncludes)) {
const backendUrl = __hijackSettings.backendUrl || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.backendUrl;
const apiPath = u.pathname.replace(/^/v1/, "");
const targetUrl = backendUrl.replace(//+$/, "") + apiPath + u.search;
try {
if (init?.method === "POST" && typeof init?.body === "string") {
const body = JSON.parse(init.body);
const aliases = __hijackSettings.modelAliases || {};
if (body.model && aliases[body.model]) {
body.model = aliases[body.model];
init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
}
}
} catch (e) {}
console.log("[hijack] API ->", targetUrl);
return originalFetch(targetUrl, init);
}
return originalFetch(input, init);
}
request.toString = () => globalThis.__fetch.toString();
globalThis.fetch = request;
// HOOK 2: XHR override — blocked-send fake-response approach (no about:blank, no CSP issues)
if (globalThis.XMLHttpRequest) {
if (!globalThis.__xhrOpen) { globalThis.__xhrOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open; }
const origXhrSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;
XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url, ...args) {
this.__hijack_url = url;
this.__hijack_blocked = false;
if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, discardIncludes)) {
this.__hijack_blocked = true;
}
if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, telemetryIncludes)) {
this.__hijack_blocked = true;
}
if (isMatch(url, authIncludes)) {
this.__hijack_blocked = true;
}
if (!this.__hijack_blocked) {
globalThis.__xhrOpen.call(this, method, url, ...args);
}
};
XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function (...args) {
if (this.__hijack_blocked) {
const fakeBody = fakeAuthBody(this.__hijack_url || "");
Object.defineProperty(this, "status", { get: () => 200, configurable: true });
Object.defineProperty(this, "readyState", { get: () => 4, configurable: true });
Object.defineProperty(this, "responseText", { get: () => fakeBody, configurable: true });
Object.defineProperty(this, "response", { get: () => fakeBody, configurable: true });
setTimeout(() => {
this.dispatchEvent(new Event("readystatechange"));
this.dispatchEvent(new Event("load"));
this.dispatchEvent(new Event("loadend"));
if (typeof this.onreadystatechange === "function") this.onreadystatechange();
if (typeof this.onload === "function") this.onload();
}, 0);
return;
}
return origXhrSend.apply(this, args);
};
}
// HOOK 3: chrome.tabs.create override
if (chrome?.tabs?.create) {
if (!globalThis.__createTab) { globalThis.__createTab = chrome.tabs.create; }
chrome.tabs.create = async function (...args) {
const url = args[0]?.url;
if (url && url.startsWith("https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize")) {
args[0].url = chrome.runtime.getURL("options.html");
return globalThis.__createTab.apply(chrome.tabs, args);
}
if (url && url === "https://claude.ai/upgrade?max=c") {
args[0].url = chrome.runtime.getURL("options.html");
return globalThis.__createTab.apply(chrome.tabs, args);
}
return globalThis.__createTab.apply(chrome.tabs, args);
};
}
// HOOK 4: sidePanel override (non-Chrome browsers)
if (chrome?.sidePanel?.open) {
if (!globalThis.__openSidePanel) { globalThis.__openSidePanel = chrome.sidePanel.open; }
const isChrome = typeof navigator !== "undefined" &&
navigator.userAgentData?.brands?.some((b) => b.brand === "Google Chrome");
if (!isChrome) {
chrome.sidePanel.open = async function (...args) {
const open = globalThis.__openSidePanel;
const result = await open.apply(chrome.sidePanel, args);
const contexts = await chrome.runtime.getContexts({ contextTypes: ["SIDE_PANEL"] });
const success = contexts.length > 0;
if (!success) {
chrome.tabs.create({ url: "/arc.html" });
}
return result;
};
}
}
// HOOK 5: patchLocales
function patchLocales(module, localesVar, localMapVar) {
if (!globalThis.window) return;

OUTPUT_DIR = Path(f"claude-hijacked-{TIMESTAMP}")
CRX_FILE = Path("claude-official.crx")
def download_crx():
if CRX_FILE.exists():
print(f"[OK] CRX already exists: {CRX_FILE}")
return
urls = [
f"https://clients2.google.com/service/update2/crx?response=redirect&prodversion=130.0&x=id%3D{EXTENSION_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",
f"https://edge.microsoft.com/extensionwebstorebase/v1/crx?response=redirect&x=id%3D{EXTENSION_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",
]
for url in urls:
print("[...] Trying CRX download...")
try:
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
data = resp.read()
if len(data) < 10000:
continue
CRX_FILE.write_bytes(data)
print(f"[OK] Downloaded CRX: {len(data)} bytes")
return
except Exception as e:
print(f"[WARN] {e}")
print(f"\n[ERROR] Could not download CRX.")
print(f" 1. Download from Chrome Web Store with ID: {EXTENSION_ID}")
print(f" 2. Save as: {CRX_FILE}")
sys.exit(1)
def extract_crx():
if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir()
data = CRX_FILE.read_bytes()
if data[:4] == b"Cr24":
ver = struct.unpack("<I", data[4:8])[0]
if ver == 3:
hl = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
zs = 12 + hl
elif ver == 2:
pk = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
sg = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]
zs = 16 + pk + sg
else:
sys.exit(f"Unknown CRX version: {ver}")
else:
zs = 0
zp = Path("_temp.zip")
zp.write_bytes(data[zs:])
with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, "r") as zf:
zf.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
zp.unlink()
files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)) for p in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
print(f"[OK] Extracted {len(files)} files:")
for f in files:
print(f" {f}")
return files

def patch_manifest(m):
changes = []

KEEP key field — this IS the ID hijack
if "key" in m:
changes.append("KEPT key (ID hijack)")

REMOVE update_url
if "update_url" in m:
del m["update_url"]
changes.append("REMOVED update_url")

ADD options_page (overwrites official options.html reference)
m["options_page"] = "options.html"
changes.append("SET options_page")

ADD host_permissions
hp = m.get("host_permissions", [])
for h in ["http://127.0.0.1/", "http://localhost/", "http:///"]:
if h not in hp:
hp.append(h)
m["host_permissions"] = hp
changes.append("ADDED host_permissions http:///")

Ensure storage permission
perms = m.get("permissions", [])
if "storage" not in perms:
perms.append("storage")
m["permissions"] = perms
changes.append("ADDED storage permission")

PATCH CSP connect-src to allow local backend URLs
csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {})
if isinstance(csp, dict):
policy = csp.get("extension_pages", "")
if "connect-src" in policy:
policy = policy.replace(
"connect-src",
"connect-src http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* http://:"
)
else:
policy = policy.rstrip(";").rstrip() + (
"; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* http://:"
)
csp["extension_pages"] = policy
changes.append("PATCHED CSP connect-src for local backends")
m["content_security_policy"] = csp
with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
json.dump(m, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json patched:")
for c in changes:
print(f" {c}")
return m

function isMatch(u, includes) {
if (typeof u === "string") {
try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }
}
return includes.some((v) => {
if (u.host === v) return true;
if (u.href.startsWith(v)) return true;
if (u.pathname.startsWith(v)) return true;
if (v[0] === "*" && (u.host + u.pathname).indexOf(v.slice(1)) !== -1) return true;
return false;
});
}

Here's EVERYTHING I found about the API Key button and the Demo button:

THE API KEY BUTTON ON THE OPTIONS PAGE
How it works: Cocodem does NOT create a separate options page. They keep the original extension's options.html intact and inject UI elements into it dynamically at runtime using the ui config from __cfc_options.
The mechanism (lines 281-293 of request.js):
The render() function runs on DOMContentLoaded and popstate:

Gets ui from globalThis.__cfc_options
Looks up ui[location.pathname] — so for /options.html, it gets ui["/options.html"]
For each item in that config, does document.querySelector(item.selector).innerHTML = item.html

Where the config comes from: The ui and uiNodes config is served by the cfcBase server at GET /api/options?id=EXT_ID&v=VERSION. This is NOT hardcoded in request.js — it's DYNAMIC from the cloud server. The default values are ui: {} and uiNodes: [] (lines 73-74), meaning if the server doesn't return anything, no UI modifications happen.
What the options.png screenshot shows: The original options page has a left sidebar. Cocodem injects:

"API configuration (internal)" as a new sidebar tab (the first/selected one)
When selected, it shows: ANTHROPIC API BASE URL input, ANTHROPIC API KEY input, "Save API Key" button
The original tabs (Model selection, Permissions, Scheduled tasks) remain below it

The uiNodes + JSX system (lines 376-462): For React-rendered content (like the sidepanel), cocodem uses a more sophisticated approach:

matchJsx(node, selector) — recursively checks if a JSX node matches a selector pattern
remixJsx(node, renderNode) — takes a JSX node and applies uiNodes transformations (prepend, append, or replace children)
setJsx(n) — hooks into React's jsx() function by wrapping n.jsx and n.jsxs with _jsx which calls remixJsx before rendering

This system lets the cfcBase server inject, remove, or modify ANY React component in the extension's UI.
Line 302-303: if (location.pathname == "/options.html") { } — this block is EMPTY in the published code. The options page modifications are handled entirely through the ui config from the server.

THE DEMO BUTTON ON 111724.XYZ
What it is: The https://openclaude.111724.xyz/ site is cocodem's cloud cfcBase server. When the user clicks the Login/Sign Up button in the extension, the chrome.tabs.create override (lines 224-244) intercepts the URL:

Original extension tries to open https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&scope=...
The override replaces https://claude.ai/ with cfcBase (e.g., https://openclaude.111724.xyz/)
It replaces the hardcoded extension ID fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn with chrome.runtime.id (the actual loaded extension's ID)
Appends &v=VERSION
So the user gets sent to: https://openclaude.111724.xyz/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&scope=...&v=1.0.47

What happens on that page (the "Demo" button): We can't see the server code (it's closed-source), but from the onMessageExternal listener (lines 246-279), we know the page can send messages back to the extension:

"_api_key_mode" — switches to API key mode (the "Use API Key" / Demo button presumably sends this)
"_claude_account_mode" — switches to Claude account mode
"_set_storage_local" — sets auth tokens in chrome.storage.local (this is how the login actually works — the page generates fake tokens and sends them back)
"_update_options" — forces options refresh
"_open_options" — opens the options page
"_create_tab" — creates a new tab

Note on sender.origin (line 249): Cocodem OVERRIDES sender.origin to always be "https://claude.ai" — this is a security bypass so that messages from their domain are accepted regardless of actual origin.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR OUR BUILD
Our current main.py creates a SEPARATE options.html ("Backend Settings") and skips injecting hijack.js into the original options.html. This is WRONG — it's not what cocodem does.
Cocodem's approach:

Keeps the original options.html completely untouched
Injects hijack.js into ALL pages including options.html
The ui config from cfcBase dynamically adds the "API configuration (internal)" tab
Our local CFC proxy on port 8520 needs to serve the ui config that injects our Backend Settings UI into the original options page

So the fix is: Stop skipping options.html injection, stop writing a custom options.html, and instead have the CFC proxy serve the ui config that injects the API Key / Backend Settings button into the ORIGINAL options page.

The API Key Button — not hardcoded, not in the extension. It comes from /api/options's ui field. The render() function in request.js does document.querySelector(selector).innerHTML = html when the options page loads. That's it. The server controls what button appears and what it says.

What you found that matters: The sender.origin = "https://claude.ai" override is INSIDE the listener body — it doesn't bypass Chrome's externally_connectable check (Chrome enforces that before calling the listener), but it bypasses any further sender.origin checks inside the handler. This means we MUST add http://localhost:{port}/* to externally_connectable.matches in the manifest — otherwise Chrome won't call the listener at all.

What was wrong with every previous version: Replacing options.html, injecting hijack.js into the service worker, skipping options.html injection — all wrong. Here's what I found beyond what you found:

1. The proxy URL construction is critical — you can't just match on path. request.js does cfcBase + u.href which means the proxy receives GET /https://api.anthropic.com/api/bootstrap — the full original URL as a path suffix. For discardIncludes it's (cfcBase + u.href).replace("/https://", "/") → GET /cdn.segment.com/.... The proxy must match on these patterns, not simple path prefixes.

2. Fake JWT iss field matters — clearApiKeyLogin() only clears tokens where the payload has iss == "auth". Our fake tokens must have iss: "cfc" or anything other than "auth", otherwise they get wiped when mode switches.

3. anthropicBaseUrl eliminates localStorage sync — request.js falls back to anthropicBaseUrl from /api/options if localStorage.apiBaseUrl isn't set. We can set "anthropicBaseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1" in our options response and LLM calls route correctly without any _set_storage_local sync.

4. The render() bug in the guide — the guide says Object.values(optionsUi) but optionsUi is never declared there. The compiled code uses pageUi (the ui[location.pathname] result). The guide has a variable name typo. The real code iterates Object.values(pageUi).

5. _optionsPromise 2.8s timeout — if our proxy is slow, getOptions() resolves with defaults after 2.8s. Our proxy must respond to /api/options in under 2.8 seconds or auth faking won't activate before the first render.

THE COMPLETE CHAIN
Step 1: Extension loads → hijack.js fetches config from cfcBase
getOptions() (line 81) calls GET cfcBase/api/options?id=EXT_ID&v=VERSION. The cfcBase server returns a JSON config that includes uiNodes — these are JSX tree manipulations that get applied to the React UI at render time via setJsx/remixJsx/matchJsx.
Step 2: uiNodes inject the "🔑 API KEY" button in THREE places
I hit the ACTUAL endpoint at https://openclaude.111724.xyz/api/options?id=fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn&v=1.0.66 and got the real response. There are 3 uiNodes:
uiNode 1 — On the options page, finds the div containing {label, htmlFor: "apiKey"} and APPENDS a link: "🔑 API KEY ↗" pointing to https://openclaude.111724.xyz/#api. Also appends "Base URL and Model Alias Configuration" link.
uiNode 2 — On the right-click context menu (div with role: "menu", data-radix-menu-content), PREPENDS "🔑 API KEY ↗" link to https://openclaude.111724.xyz/#api.
uiNode 3 — On the login screen, finds the "Log in" button (button with className "underline cursor-pointer text-text-100 opacity-90 hover:opacity-100") and REPLACES it with an <a> tag saying "Log in" that links to https://openclaude.111724.xyz/#api.
Step 3: User clicks "🔑 API KEY" → goes to cfcBase login page
This opens https://openclaude.111724.xyz/#api in a new tab. That page has:

Email / Username / License Key fields + "Activate Now" button (for paid users)
"Purchase Pro License" button
"ADVANCED OPTIONS" section

Step 4: User clicks Login/Sign Up inside the extension → chrome.tabs.create override kicks in
When the extension's original code calls chrome.tabs.create({url: "https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize?..."}), the hijack.js override (line 224-244):

Replaces https://claude.ai/ with cfcBase
Replaces the hardcoded extension ID with chrome.runtime.id
Appends &v=VERSION
Opens: cfcBase/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&scope=...&v=1.0.66

Step 5: The cfcBase oauth/authorize page shows three buttons
I accessed https://openclaude.111724.xyz/oauth/authorize?client_id=test&response_type=code&scope=user and saw:

"Download Extension" — links to /open-claude-in-chrome
"Login" — links to the REAL https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize?... (real Anthropic login)
"Free Trial" ← THIS IS THE "DEMO" BUTTON — links to cfcBase/oauth/redirect?client_id=...&scope=...

Step 6: User clicks "Free Trial" → oauth/redirect page
The /oauth/redirect page shows "Signed in successfully!" and runs this JavaScript:

Gets redirect_uri and state from URL params
Builds a new URL from redirect_uri
Generates a random 32-byte value, base64-encodes it URL-safe
Sets code = cfc- + that random string
Sets state if present
Calls chrome.runtime.sendMessage(redirectUri.host, {redirect_uri: newUrl.toString(), type: "oauth_redirect"}) — where .host extracts the extension ID from the chrome-extension://ID/... redirect_uri

Step 7: Extension receives oauth_redirect → processes fake code
The onMessageExternal in request.js does NOT have an oauth_redirect handler. The ORIGINAL extension's code handles it — it takes the redirect_uri and processes it as if the oauth flow completed. The extension then calls POST https://console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token with the cfc- code.
Step 8: Token request intercepted by fetch hook
In request.js line 152-161: The fetch hook checks if the code starts with "cfc-". If it does, it does NOT passthrough to the real API. It falls through to the isMatch(u, proxyIncludes) check (line 188), which matches console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token. The request gets proxied to cfcBase + url.
Step 9: cfcBase returns fake tokens
The cfcBase server at cfcBase/https://console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token returns a fake accessToken, refreshToken, and tokenExpiry. The extension stores these in chrome.storage.local and considers the user logged in.
Step 10: All subsequent API calls redirected
Auth endpoints (profile, bootstrap, account, organizations, etc.) in proxyIncludes get proxied through cfcBase. Analytics/telemetry in discardIncludes get 204'd. Actual API calls (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/) get redirected to the user's configured apiBaseUrl (their LM Studio backend).

<script>
(async () => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const redirectUriStr = params.get('redirect_uri');
  const state = params.get('state');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('msg');
  const subEl = document.getElementById('sub');

  if (!redirectUriStr) {
    msgEl.textContent = 'Error: no redirect_uri';
    msgEl.className = 'err';
    return;
  }

  // Generate cfc- code: 32 random bytes base64url-encoded
  const random = new Uint8Array(32);
  crypto.getRandomValues(random);
  const b64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...random))
    .replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=/g, '');
  const code = 'cfc-' + b64;

  // Build final redirect_uri with code (and state if present)
  const newUrl = new URL(redirectUriStr);
  newUrl.searchParams.set('code', code);
  if (state) newUrl.searchParams.set('state', state);

  // redirectUri.host IS the extension ID for chrome-extension:// URLs
  const redirectUri = new URL(redirectUriStr);
  try {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage(redirectUri.host, {
      type: 'oauth_redirect',
      redirect_uri: newUrl.toString()
    });
    msgEl.textContent = 'Signed in successfully!';
    subEl.textContent = 'Closing\u2026';
  } catch(e) {
    msgEl.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message;
    msgEl.className = 'err';
    subEl.textContent = 'Please try again.';
    return;
  }
  setTimeout(() => window.close(), 1800);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
"""

      headers: {{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}},
      body: JSON.stringify({{backend_url: url}})
    }});
    const d = await r.json();
    if (d.ok) {{ s.style.color = '#7fff7f'; s.textContent = '\u2713 Saved \u2014 new requests will use: ' + url; }}
    else {{ s.style.color = '#ff6b6b'; s.textContent = 'Error: ' + (d.error || 'unknown'); }}
  }} catch(e) {{ s.style.color = '#ff6b6b'; s.textContent = 'Request failed: ' + e.message; }}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy handler
DISCARD_HOSTS = (
    "cdn.segment.com", "api.segment.io", "events.statsigapi.net",
    "api.honeycomb.io", "prodregistryv2.org", "ingest.us.sentry.io",
    "browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com", "statsigapi.net", "api.statsigcdn.com",
    "featureassets.org", "featuregates.org", "assetsconfigcdn.org",
    "beyondwickedmapping.org",
)

CORS_HEADERS = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta",
}


class LocalCfcProxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        status = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "?"
        print(f"[proxy] {self.command:<6} {status} {self.path[:90]}")

    def _set_cors(self):
        for k, v in CORS_HEADERS.items():
            self.send_header(k, v)

    def _send_json(self, data, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_html(self, html: str, status=200):
        body = html.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_empty(self, status):
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._send_empty(200)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._route(self.path, b"")

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        self._route(self.path, body)

    def _route(self, path, body):
        # --- /api/options (must respond in <2.8s or extension uses defaults) ---
        if path.startswith("/api/options"):
            return self._send_json(make_options_response())

        # --- oauth authorize page (opened by chrome.tabs.create override) ---
        if path.startswith("/oauth/authorize"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_HTML)

        # --- oauth redirect page (Free Trial button → generates cfc- code) ---
        if path.startswith("/oauth/redirect"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_REDIRECT_HTML)

        # --- token exchange (cfc- code exchange, proxied here by request.js) ---
        # Arrives as: /https://console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token
        #         or: /https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token
        if "oauth/token" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_TOKEN)

        # --- auth profile ---
        if "oauth/profile" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_PROFILE)

        # --- bootstrap ---
        if "api/bootstrap" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_BOOTSTRAP)

        # --- account (must check before organizations since "account" is substring) ---
        if "oauth/account" in path and "organizations" not in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_ACCOUNT)

        # --- organizations ---
        if "oauth/organizations" in path:
            return self._send_json([FAKE_ORG])

        # --- chat conversations ---
        if "chat_conversations" in path:
            return self._send_json({"conversations": []})

        # --- domain info ---
        if "domain_info" in path:
            return self._send_json({"domain": "local", "allowed": True})

        # --- discard analytics (return 204, no body) ---
        if any(h in path for h in DISCARD_HOSTS):
            return self._send_empty(204)

        # --- catch-all for remaining Anthropic API auth endpoints ---
        if "api.anthropic.com/api/" in path or "console.anthropic.com" in path:
            return self._send_json({})

        # --- forward /v1/ LLM calls to LM Studio backend ---
        if "/v1/" in path and self.command == "POST":
            return self._forward_to_backend(path, body)

        # --- settings API ---
        if path == "/api/settings" and self.command == "POST":
            return self._handle_settings(body)

        # --- settings / root page ---
        if (path in ("/", "/settings") or
                path.startswith("/#") or path.startswith("/?") or
                path.startswith("/settings")):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        # --- upgrade redirect (cfcBase receives claude.ai/upgrade redirects) ---
        if "upgrade" in path or path.startswith("/?from="):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        # --- default: empty 200 (don't 404 — extension may send unknown requests) ---
        return self._send_json({})

    def _handle_settings(self, body):
        global BACKEND_URL
        try:
            data = json.loads(body)
            new_url = data.get("backend_url", "").strip()
            if new_url:
                BACKEND_URL = new_url
                print(f"[config] backend_url → {BACKEND_URL}")
            return self._send_json({"ok": True})
        except Exception as e:
            return self._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}, 400)

    def _forward_to_backend(self, path, body):
        # Extract the /v1/... suffix; strip any /https://... prefix wrapping
        idx = path.find("/v1/")
        suffix = path[idx:]
        url = BACKEND_URL.rstrip("/") + suffix

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": self.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json"),
        }
        for h in ("Authorization", "x-api-key", "anthropic-version", "anthropic-beta"):
            v = self.headers.get(h)
            if v:
                headers[h] = v

        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST")
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
                status = resp.status
                ct = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json")
                resp_body = resp.read()
            self.send_response(status)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", ct)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(resp_body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(resp_body)
        except urllib.error.URLError as e:
            msg = f"Backend unreachable ({BACKEND_URL}): {e}".encode()
            self.send_response(502)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(msg)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(msg)
            print(f"[!] Backend error: {e}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ extension setup
def download_zip():
    for url in ZIP_URLS:
        version = url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        print(f"[*] Downloading {version} ... ", end="", flush=True)
        try:
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, ZIP_CACHE)
            print("OK")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"failed ({e})")
    print("[-] Could not download any cocodem ZIP. Check your internet connection.")
    sys.exit(1)

def patch_request_js():

    if not p.exists():
        print(f"[-] request.js not found at {p} — skipping cfcBase patch")
        return
    content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    patched, n = re.subn(
        r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"https://openclaude\.111724\.xyz/"[^\n]*',
        f'const cfcBase = "http://localhost:{PORT}/"',

        print(f"[+] Patched request.js — cfcBase = http://localhost:{PORT}/")
    else:

        patched2, n2 = re.subn(

        )
        if n2:

            print(f"[+] Patched request.js (fallback pattern) — cfcBase = http://localhost:{PORT}/")


def patch_manifest():
    mp = OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json"
    if not mp.exists():
        print("[-] manifest.json not found")
        return
    m = json.loads(mp.read_text())

    # 1. Remove update_url (required to load as unpacked extension)
    m.pop("update_url", None)

    # 2. Add http://127.0.0.1/* to externally_connectable
    ec = m.setdefault("externally_connectable", {})
    ec_matches = ec.setdefault("matches", [])
    if "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in ec_matches:
        ec_matches.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    # 3. Add http://127.0.0.1/* to content_scripts that target localhost:8787
    for cs in m.get("content_scripts", []):
        cs_m = cs.get("matches", [])
        if "http://localhost:8787/*" in cs_m and "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in cs_m:
            cs_m.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    for war in m.get("web_accessible_resources", []):
        war_m = war.get("matches", [])
        if "http://localhost:8787/*" in war_m and "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in war_m:
            war_m.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    mp.write_text(json.dumps(m, indent=2))
    print("[+] Patched manifest.json — removed update_url, added 127.0.0.1/* to externally_connectable")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy server
def run_proxy():
    socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
    with socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(("", PORT), LocalCfcProxy) as httpd:
        print(f"\n[+] Local CFC proxy  →  http://localhost:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] LLM backend      →  {BACKEND_URL}")
        print(f"[+] Settings page    →  http://localhost:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] Press Ctrl+C to stop\n")
        try:
            httpd.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[*] Proxy stopped")

function isMatch(u, includes) {
if (typeof u === "string") {
try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }
}
return includes.some((v) => {
if (u.host === v) return true;
if (u.href.startsWith(v)) return true;
if (u.pathname.startsWith(v)) return true;
if (v[0] === "*" && (u.host + u.pathname).indexOf(v.slice(1)) !== -1) return true;
return false;
});
}

OAUTH_REDIRECT_HTML = """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Signing in\u2026</title>
<style>
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;background:#0f0f1a;color:#e8e8f0}

  <h2 id="msg">Signing in\u2026</h2>
  <p id="sub">Please wait.</p>
</div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const redirectUriStr = params.get('redirect_uri');
  const state = params.get('state');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('msg');
  const subEl = document.getElementById('sub');

  if (!redirectUriStr) {
    msgEl.textContent = 'Error: no redirect_uri';
    msgEl.className = 'err';
    return;
  }

  // Generate cfc- code: 32 random bytes base64url-encoded
  const random = new Uint8Array(32);
  crypto.getRandomValues(random);
  const b64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...random))
    .replace(/\\+/g, '-').replace(/\\//g, '_').replace(/=/g, '');
  const code = 'cfc-' + b64;

  // Build final redirect_uri with code (and state if present)
  const newUrl = new URL(redirectUriStr);
  newUrl.searchParams.set('code', code);
  if (state) newUrl.searchParams.set('state', state);

  // redirectUri.host IS the extension ID for chrome-extension:// URLs
  const redirectUri = new URL(redirectUriStr);
  try {
    // Use _set_storage_local — the actual handler in request.js onMessageExternal
    const header  = btoa(JSON.stringify({alg:"none",typ:"JWT"}));
    const payload = btoa(JSON.stringify({iss:"local",sub:"local-user",exp:9999999999,iat:Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)}));
    const token   = header + "." + payload + ".local";
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage(redirectUri.host, {
      type: '_set_storage_local',
      data: {
        accessToken:  token,
        refreshToken: "local-refresh",
        tokenExpiry:  Date.now() + 31536000000
      }
    });
    msgEl.textContent = 'Signed in successfully!';
    subEl.textContent = 'Closing\u2026';
  } catch(e) {
    msgEl.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message;
    msgEl.className = 'err';
    subEl.textContent = 'Please try again.';
    return;
  }
  setTimeout(() => window.close(), 1800);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
"""

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy handler
DISCARD_HOSTS = (
    "cdn.segment.com", "api.segment.io", "events.statsigapi.net",
    "api.honeycomb.io", "prodregistryv2.org", "ingest.us.sentry.io",
    "browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com", "statsigapi.net", "api.statsigcdn.com",
    "featureassets.org", "featuregates.org", "assetsconfigcdn.org",
    "beyondwickedmapping.org",
)

CORS_HEADERS = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta",
}


class LocalCfcProxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        status = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "?"
        print(f"[proxy] {self.command:<6} {status} {self.path[:90]}")

    def _set_cors(self):
        for k, v in CORS_HEADERS.items():
            self.send_header(k, v)

    def _send_json(self, data, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_html(self, html: str, status=200):
        body = html.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_empty(self, status):
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._send_empty(200)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._route(self.path, b"")

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        self._route(self.path, body)

    def _route(self, path, body):
        # --- /api/options (must respond in <2.8s or extension uses defaults) ---
        if path.startswith("/api/options"):
            return self._send_json(make_options_response())

        # --- oauth authorize page (opened by chrome.tabs.create override) ---
        if path.startswith("/oauth/authorize"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_HTML)

        # --- oauth redirect page (Free Trial button → sets tokens via _set_storage_local) ---
        if path.startswith("/oauth/redirect"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_REDIRECT_HTML)

        # --- arc.html split-view data ---
        if "/api/arc-split-view" in path:
            return self._send_json({"html": "<div></div>"})

        # --- token exchange (cfc- code exchange, proxied here by request.js) ---
        # Arrives as: /https://console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token
        #         or: /https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token
        if "oauth/token" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_TOKEN)

        # --- auth profile ---
        if "oauth/profile" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_PROFILE)

        # --- bootstrap ---
        if "api/bootstrap" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_BOOTSTRAP)

        # --- account (must check before organizations since "account" is substring) ---
        if "oauth/account" in path and "organizations" not in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_ACCOUNT)

        # --- organizations ---
        if "oauth/organizations" in path:
            return self._send_json([FAKE_ORG])

        # --- chat conversations ---
        if "chat_conversations" in path:
            return self._send_json({"conversations": []})

        # --- domain info ---
        if "domain_info" in path:
            return self._send_json({"domain": "local", "allowed": True})

        # --- discard analytics (return 204, no body) ---
        if any(h in path for h in DISCARD_HOSTS):
            return self._send_empty(204)

        # --- catch-all for remaining Anthropic API auth endpoints ---
        if "api.anthropic.com/api/" in path or "console.anthropic.com" in path:
            return self._send_json({})

        # --- forward /v1/ LLM calls to LM Studio backend ---
        if "/v1/" in path and self.command == "POST":
            return self._forward_to_backend(path, body)

        # --- settings API ---
        if path == "/api/settings" and self.command == "POST":
            return self._handle_settings(body)

        # --- settings / root page ---
        if (path in ("/", "/settings") or
                path.startswith("/#") or path.startswith("/?") or
                path.startswith("/settings")):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        # --- upgrade redirect (cfcBase receives claude.ai/upgrade redirects) ---
        if "upgrade" in path or path.startswith("/?from="):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        # --- default: empty 200 (don't 404 — extension may send unknown requests) ---
        return self._send_json({})

    def _handle_settings(self, body):
        global BACKEND_URL
        try:
            data = json.loads(body)
            new_url = data.get("backend_url", "").strip()
            if new_url:
                BACKEND_URL = new_url
                print(f"[config] backend_url → {BACKEND_URL}")
            return self._send_json({"ok": True})
        except Exception as e:
            return self._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}, 400)

    def _forward_to_backend(self, path, body):
        # Extract the /v1/... suffix; strip any /https://... prefix wrapping
        idx = path.find("/v1/")
        suffix = path[idx:]
        url = BACKEND_URL.rstrip("/") + suffix

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": self.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json"),
        }
        for h in ("Authorization", "x-api-key", "anthropic-version", "anthropic-beta"):
            v = self.headers.get(h)
            if v:
                headers[h] = v

        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST")
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
                status = resp.status
                ct = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json")
                resp_body = resp.read()
            self.send_response(status)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", ct)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(resp_body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(resp_body)
        except urllib.error.URLError as e:
            msg = f"Backend unreachable ({BACKEND_URL}): {e}".encode()
            self.send_response(502)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(msg)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(msg)
            print(f"[!] Backend error: {e}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ extension setup
def download_zip():
    for url in ZIP_URLS:
        version = url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        print(f"[*] Downloading {version} ... ", end="", flush=True)
        try:
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, ZIP_CACHE)
            print("OK")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"failed ({e})")
    print("[-] Could not download any cocodem ZIP. Check your internet connection.")
    sys.exit(1)


def extract_zip():
    if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_CACHE) as z:
        z.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
    print(f"[+] Extracted to {OUTPUT_DIR}")


def patch_request_js():
    p = OUTPUT_DIR / "assets" / "request.js"
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"[-] request.js not found at {p} — skipping cfcBase patch")
        return
    content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    patched, n = re.subn(
        r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"https://openclaude\.111724\.xyz/"[^\n]*',
        f'const cfcBase = "http://localhost:{PORT}/"',
        content
    )
    if n:
        p.write_text(patched, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[+] Patched request.js — cfcBase = http://localhost:{PORT}/")
    else:
        print("[!] cfcBase pattern not matched in request.js (version mismatch?)")
        # Try fallback pattern for other versions
        patched2, n2 = re.subn(
            r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"[^"]*111724[^"]*"[^\n]*',
            f'const cfcBase = "http://localhost:{PORT}/"',
            content
        )
        if n2:
            p.write_text(patched2, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"[+] Patched request.js (fallback pattern) — cfcBase = http://localhost:{PORT}/")


def patch_manifest():
    mp = OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json"
    if not mp.exists():
        print("[-] manifest.json not found")
        return
    m = json.loads(mp.read_text())

    # 1. Remove update_url (required to load as unpacked extension)
    m.pop("update_url", None)

    # 2. Add http://127.0.0.1/* to externally_connectable
    #    (localhost is already there; 127.0.0.1 is treated as distinct origin by Chrome)
    ec = m.setdefault("externally_connectable", {})
    ec_matches = ec.setdefault("matches", [])
    if "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in ec_matches:
        ec_matches.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    # 3. Add http://127.0.0.1/* to content_scripts that target localhost:8787
    for cs in m.get("content_scripts", []):
        cs_m = cs.get("matches", [])
        if "http://localhost:8787/*" in cs_m and "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in cs_m:
            cs_m.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    # 4. Add http://127.0.0.1/* to web_accessible_resources that target localhost:8787
    for war in m.get("web_accessible_resources", []):
        war_m = war.get("matches", [])
        if "http://localhost:8787/*" in war_m and "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in war_m:
            war_m.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    mp.write_text(json.dumps(m, indent=2))
    print("[+] Patched manifest.json — removed update_url, added 127.0.0.1/* to externally_connectable")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy server
def run_proxy():
    socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
    with socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(("", PORT), LocalCfcProxy) as httpd:
        print(f"\n[+] Local CFC proxy  →  http://localhost:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] LLM backend      →  {BACKEND_URL}")
        print(f"[+] Settings page    →  http://localhost:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] Press Ctrl+C to stop\n")
        try:
            httpd.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[*] Proxy stopped")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ entry point
def main():
    print("=" * 62)
    print("  LOCAL CFC PROXY — cocodem/claude-for-chrome equivalent")
    print("=" * 62)

    # Download cocodem ZIP if not cached
    if not ZIP_CACHE.exists():
        print("[*] Downloading cocodem extension ZIP from GitHub...")
        download_zip()
    else:
        print(f"[+] Using cached ZIP: {ZIP_CACHE.name}")

    # Extract and patch extension if OUTPUT_DIR doesn't exist
    if not OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        print("[*] Extracting and patching extension...")
        extract_zip()
        patch_request_js()
        patch_manifest()
        print(f"\n[+] Extension ready: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
        print("\n  Load in Chrome:")
        print("  1. Open chrome://extensions/")
        print("  2. Enable Developer mode (top-right toggle)")
        print("  3. Click 'Load unpacked'")
        print(f"  4. Select: {OUTPUT_DIR}\n")
    else:
        print(f"[+] Extension at: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
        print("    (delete that folder to re-extract and re-patch)")

    run_proxy()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy handler
DISCARD_HOSTS = (
    "cdn.segment.com", "api.segment.io", "events.statsigapi.net",
    "api.honeycomb.io", "prodregistryv2.org", "ingest.us.sentry.io",
    "browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com", "statsigapi.net", "api.statsigcdn.com",
    "featureassets.org", "featuregates.org", "assetsconfigcdn.org",
    "beyondwickedmapping.org",
)

CORS_HEADERS = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta",
}


class LocalCfcProxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        status = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "?"
        print(f"[proxy] {self.command:<6} {status} {self.path[:90]}")

    def _set_cors(self):
        for k, v in CORS_HEADERS.items():
            self.send_header(k, v)

    def _send_json(self, data, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_html(self, html: str, status=200):
        body = html.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_empty(self, status):
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._send_empty(200)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._route(self.path, b"")

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        self._route(self.path, body)

    def _route(self, path, body):
        if path.startswith("/api/options"):
            return self._send_json(make_options_response())

        if path.startswith("/oauth/authorize"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_HTML)

        if path.startswith("/oauth/redirect"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_REDIRECT_HTML)

        if "/api/arc-split-view" in path:
            return self._send_json({"html": "<div></div>"})

        if "oauth/token" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_TOKEN)

        if "oauth/profile" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_PROFILE)

        if "api/bootstrap" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_BOOTSTRAP)

        if "oauth/account" in path and "organizations" not in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_ACCOUNT)

        if "oauth/organizations" in path:
            return self._send_json([FAKE_ORG])

        if "chat_conversations" in path:
            return self._send_json({"conversations": []})

        if "domain_info" in path:
            return self._send_json({"domain": "local", "allowed": True})

        if any(h in path for h in DISCARD_HOSTS):
            return self._send_empty(204)

        if "api.anthropic.com/api/" in path or "console.anthropic.com" in path:
            return self._send_json({})

        if "/v1/" in path and self.command == "POST":
            return self._forward_to_backend(path, body)

        if path == "/api/settings" and self.command == "POST":
            return self._handle_settings(body)

        if (path in ("/", "/settings") or
                path.startswith("/#") or path.startswith("/?") or
                path.startswith("/settings")):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        if "upgrade" in path or path.startswith("/?from="):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        return self._send_json({})

    def _handle_settings(self, body):
        global BACKEND_URL
        try:
            data = json.loads(body)
            new_url = data.get("backend_url", "").strip()
            if new_url:
                BACKEND_URL = new_url
                print(f"[config] backend_url → {BACKEND_URL}")
            return self._send_json({"ok": True})
        except Exception as e:
            return self._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}, 400)

    def _forward_to_backend(self, path, body):
        idx = path.find("/v1/")
        suffix = path[idx:]
        url = BACKEND_URL.rstrip("/") + suffix

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": self.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json"),
        }
        for h in ("Authorization", "x-api-key", "anthropic-version", "anthropic-beta"):
            v = self.headers.get(h)
            if v:
                headers[h] = v

        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST")
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
                status = resp.status
                ct = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json")
                resp_body = resp.read()
            self.send_response(status)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", ct)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(resp_body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(resp_body)
        except urllib.error.URLError as e:
            msg = f"Backend unreachable ({BACKEND_URL}): {e}".encode()
            self.send_response(502)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(msg)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(msg)
            print(f"[!] Backend error: {e}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ extension setup
def download_zip():
    for url in ZIP_URLS:
        version = url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        print(f"[*] Downloading {version} ... ", end="", flush=True)
        try:
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, ZIP_CACHE)
            print("OK")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"failed ({e})")
    print("[-] Could not download any cocodem ZIP. Check your internet connection.")
    sys.exit(1)


def extract_zip():
    if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_CACHE) as z:
        z.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
    print(f"[+] Extracted to {OUTPUT_DIR}")


def patch_request_js():
    p = OUTPUT_DIR / "assets" / "request.js"
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"[-] request.js not found at {p} — skipping cfcBase patch")
        return
    content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    patched, n = re.subn(
        r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"https://openclaude\.111724\.xyz/"[^\n]*',
        f'const cfcBase = "http://localhost:{PORT}/"',
        content
    )
    if n:
        p.write_text(patched, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[+] Patched request.js — cfcBase = http://localhost:{PORT}/")
    else:
        print("[!] cfcBase pattern not matched in request.js (version mismatch?)")
        patched2, n2 = re.subn(
            r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"[^"]*111724[^"]*"[^\n]*',
            f'const cfcBase = "http://localhost:{PORT}/"',
            content
        )
        if n2:
            p.write_text(patched2, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"[+] Patched request.js (fallback) — cfcBase = http://localhost:{PORT}/")


def patch_manifest():
    mp = OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json"
    if not mp.exists():
        print("[-] manifest.json not found")
        return
    m = json.loads(mp.read_text())

    m.pop("update_url", None)

    ec = m.setdefault("externally_connectable", {})
    ec_matches = ec.setdefault("matches", [])
    if "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in ec_matches:
        ec_matches.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    for cs in m.get("content_scripts", []):
        cs_m = cs.get("matches", [])
        if "http://localhost:8787/*" in cs_m and "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in cs_m:
            cs_m.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    for war in m.get("web_accessible_resources", []):
        war_m = war.get("matches", [])
        if "http://localhost:8787/*" in war_m and "http://127.0.0.1/*" not in war_m:
            war_m.append("http://127.0.0.1/*")

    mp.write_text(json.dumps(m, indent=2))
    print("[+] Patched manifest.json — removed update_url, added 127.0.0.1/* to externally_connectable")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy server
def run_proxy():
    socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
    with socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(("", PORT), LocalCfcProxy) as httpd:
        print(f"\n[+] Local CFC proxy  →  http://localhost:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] LLM backend      →  {BACKEND_URL}")
        print(f"[+] Settings page    →  http://localhost:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] Press Ctrl+C to stop\n")
        try:
            httpd.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[*] Proxy stopped")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ entry point
def main():
    print("=" * 62)
    print("  LOCAL CFC PROXY — cocodem/claude-for-chrome equivalent")
    print("=" * 62)

    if not ZIP_CACHE.exists():
        print("[*] Downloading cocodem extension ZIP from GitHub...")
        download_zip()
    else:
        print(f"[+] Using cached ZIP: {ZIP_CACHE.name}")

    if not OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        print("[*] Extracting and patching extension...")
        extract_zip()
        patch_request_js()
        patch_manifest()
        print(f"\n[+] Extension ready: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
        print("\n  Load in Chrome:")
        print("  1. Open chrome://extensions/")
        print("  2. Enable Developer mode (top-right toggle)")
        print("  3. Click 'Load unpacked'")
        print(f"  4. Select: {OUTPUT_DIR}\n")
    else:
        print(f"[+] Extension at: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
        print("    (delete that folder to re-extract and re-patch)")

    run_proxy()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def _settings_html():
    ext_path = str(OUTPUT_DIR) if OUTPUT_DIR.exists() else "(not yet extracted — run main.py first)"
    return f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Local CFC Proxy Settings</title>

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy handler
DISCARD_HOSTS = (
    "cdn.segment.com", "api.segment.io", "events.statsigapi.net",
    "api.honeycomb.io", "prodregistryv2.org", "ingest.us.sentry.io",
    "browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com", "statsigapi.net", "api.statsigcdn.com",
    "featureassets.org", "featuregates.org", "assetsconfigcdn.org",
    "beyondwickedmapping.org",
)

CORS_HEADERS = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta",
}


class LocalCfcProxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        status = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "?"
        print(f"[proxy] {self.command:<6} {status} {self.path[:90]}")

    def _set_cors(self):
        for k, v in CORS_HEADERS.items():
            self.send_header(k, v)

    def _send_json(self, data, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_html(self, html: str, status=200):
        body = html.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_empty(self, status):
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._send_empty(200)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._route(self.path, b"")

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        self._route(self.path, body)

    def _route(self, path, body):
        if path.startswith("/api/options"):
            return self._send_json(make_options_response())

        if path.startswith("/oauth/authorize"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_HTML)

        if path.startswith("/oauth/redirect"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_REDIRECT_HTML)

        if "/api/arc-split-view" in path:
            return self._send_json({"html": "<div></div>"})

        if "oauth/token" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_TOKEN)

        if "oauth/profile" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_PROFILE)

        if "api/bootstrap" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_BOOTSTRAP)

        if "oauth/account" in path and "organizations" not in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_ACCOUNT)

        if "oauth/organizations" in path:
            return self._send_json([FAKE_ORG])

        if "chat_conversations" in path:
            return self._send_json({"conversations": []})

        if "domain_info" in path:
            return self._send_json({"domain": "local", "allowed": True})

        if any(h in path for h in DISCARD_HOSTS):
            return self._send_empty(204)

        if "api.anthropic.com/api/" in path or "console.anthropic.com" in path:
            return self._send_json({})

        if "/v1/" in path and self.command == "POST":
            return self._forward_to_backend(path, body)

        if path == "/api/settings" and self.command == "POST":
            return self._handle_settings(body)

        if (path in ("/", "/settings") or
                path.startswith("/#") or path.startswith("/?") or
                path.startswith("/settings")):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        if "upgrade" in path or path.startswith("/?from="):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        return self._send_json({})

    def _handle_settings(self, body):
        global BACKEND_URL
        try:
            data = json.loads(body)
            new_url = data.get("backend_url", "").strip()
            if new_url:
                BACKEND_URL = new_url
                print(f"[config] backend_url → {BACKEND_URL}")
            return self._send_json({"ok": True})
        except Exception as e:
            return self._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}, 400)

    def _forward_to_backend(self, path, body):
        idx = path.find("/v1/")
        suffix = path[idx:]
        url = BACKEND_URL.rstrip("/") + suffix

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": self.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json"),
        }
        for h in ("Authorization", "x-api-key", "anthropic-version", "anthropic-beta"):
            v = self.headers.get(h)
            if v:
                headers[h] = v

        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST")
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
                status = resp.status
                ct = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json")
                resp_body = resp.read()
            self.send_response(status)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", ct)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(resp_body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(resp_body)
        except urllib.error.URLError as e:
            msg = f"Backend unreachable ({BACKEND_URL}): {e}".encode()
            self.send_response(502)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(msg)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(msg)
            print(f"[!] Backend error: {e}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ extension setup
def download_zip():
    for url in ZIP_URLS:
        version = url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        print(f"[*] Downloading {version} ... ", end="", flush=True)
        try:
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, ZIP_CACHE)
            print("OK")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"failed ({e})")
    print("[-] Could not download any cocodem ZIP. Check your internet connection.")
    sys.exit(1)


def extract_zip():
    if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_CACHE) as z:
        z.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
    print(f"[+] Extracted to {OUTPUT_DIR}")


def patch_request_js():
    p = OUTPUT_DIR / "assets" / "request.js"
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"[-] request.js not found at {p} — skipping cfcBase patch")
        return
    content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    patched, n = re.subn(
        r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"https://openclaude\.111724\.xyz/"[^\n]*',
        f'const cfcBase = "http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/"',
        content
    )
    if n:
        p.write_text(patched, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[+] Patched request.js — cfcBase = http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/")
    else:
        print("[!] cfcBase pattern not matched in request.js (version mismatch?)")
        patched2, n2 = re.subn(
            r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"[^"]*111724[^"]*"[^\n]*',
            f'const cfcBase = "http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/"',
            content
        )
        if n2:
            p.write_text(patched2, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"[+] Patched request.js (fallback) — cfcBase = http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/")


def patch_manifest():
    mp = OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json"
    if not mp.exists():
        print("[-] manifest.json not found")
        return
    m = json.loads(mp.read_text())

    m.pop("update_url", None)

    ec = m.setdefault("externally_connectable", {})
    ec_matches = ec.setdefault("matches", [])
    for origin in ["http://localhost:8520/*", "http://127.0.0.1:8520/*",
                   "http://localhost:8787/*", "http://127.0.0.1:8787/*",
                   f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/*", f"http://localhost:{PORT}/*"]:
        if origin not in ec_matches:
            ec_matches.append(origin)

    for cs in m.get("content_scripts", []):
        cs_m = cs.get("matches", [])
        for origin in [f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/*", f"http://localhost:{PORT}/*"]:
            if origin not in cs_m:
                cs_m.append(origin)

    for war in m.get("web_accessible_resources", []):
        war_m = war.get("matches", [])
        for origin in [f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/*", f"http://localhost:{PORT}/*"]:
            if origin not in war_m:
                war_m.append(origin)

    mp.write_text(json.dumps(m, indent=2))
    print(f"[+] Patched manifest.json — removed update_url, added 127.0.0.1:{PORT}/* to externally_connectable")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy server
def run_proxy():
    socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
    with socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(("127.0.0.1", PORT), LocalCfcProxy) as httpd:
        print(f"\n[+] Local CFC proxy  →  http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] LLM backend      →  {BACKEND_URL}")
        print(f"[+] Settings page    →  http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/")
        print(f"[+] Press Ctrl+C to stop\n")
        try:
            httpd.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[*] Proxy stopped")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ entry point
def main():
    print("=" * 62)
    print("  LOCAL CFC PROXY — cocodem/claude-for-chrome equivalent")
    print("=" * 62)

    if not ZIP_CACHE.exists():
        print("[*] Downloading cocodem extension ZIP from GitHub...")
        download_zip()
    else:
        print(f"[+] Using cached ZIP: {ZIP_CACHE.name}")

    if not OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        print("[*] Extracting and patching extension...")
        extract_zip()
        patch_request_js()
        patch_manifest()
        print(f"\n[+] Extension ready: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
        print("\n  Load in Chrome:")
        print("  1. Open chrome://extensions/")
        print("  2. Enable Developer mode (top-right toggle)")
        print("  3. Click 'Load unpacked'")
        print(f"  4. Select: {OUTPUT_DIR}\n")
    else:
        print(f"[+] Extension at: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
        print("    (delete that folder to re-extract and re-patch)")

    run_proxy()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The proxy IS working — oauth/authorize and oauth/redirect are both hitting and returning 200. The problem is visible:

/oauth/redirect serves and shows "Signed in successfully!" — but chrome.runtime.sendMessage is not awaited, so success shows even if the message was silently rejected
The currently loaded extension's manifest has http://127.0.0.1/* (no port) — Chrome does NOT match that to port 8520. externally_connectable needs http://127.0.0.1:8520/* explicitly
Delete C:\Users\Mustafa\Desktop\claude-local before running this, so the extension re-extracts with the fixed manifest.

Two fixes in the code below — awaited sendMessage with real error output, and explicit 8520 in externally_connectable:
