# ------------------------------------------------------------------ proxy handler
DISCARD_HOSTS = (
    "cdn.segment.com", "api.segment.io", "events.statsigapi.net",
    "api.honeycomb.io", "prodregistryv2.org", "ingest.us.sentry.io",
    "browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com", "statsigapi.net", "api.statsigcdn.com",
    "featureassets.org", "featuregates.org", "assetsconfigcdn.org",
    "beyondwickedmapping.org",
)

CORS_HEADERS = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta",
}


class LocalCfcProxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        status = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "?"
        print(f"[proxy] {self.command:<6} {status} {self.path[:90]}")

    def _set_cors(self):
        for k, v in CORS_HEADERS.items():
            self.send_header(k, v)

    def _send_json(self, data, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_html(self, html: str, status=200):
        body = html.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _send_empty(self, status):
        self.send_response(status)
        self._set_cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._send_empty(200)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._route(self.path, b"")

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        self._route(self.path, body)

    def _route(self, path, body):
        if path.startswith("/api/options"):
            return self._send_json(make_options_response())

        if path.startswith("/oauth/authorize"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_HTML)

        if path.startswith("/oauth/redirect"):
            return self._send_html(OAUTH_REDIRECT_HTML)

        if "/api/arc-split-view" in path:
            return self._send_json({"html": "<div></div>"})

        if "oauth/token" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_TOKEN)

        if "oauth/profile" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_PROFILE)

        if "api/bootstrap" in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_BOOTSTRAP)

        if "oauth/account" in path and "organizations" not in path:
            return self._send_json(FAKE_ACCOUNT)

        if "oauth/organizations" in path:
            return self._send_json([FAKE_ORG])

        if "chat_conversations" in path:
            return self._send_json({"conversations": []})

        if "domain_info" in path:
            return self._send_json({"domain": "local", "allowed": True})

        if any(h in path for h in DISCARD_HOSTS):
            return self._send_empty(204)

        if "api.anthropic.com/api/" in path or "console.anthropic.com" in path:
            return self._send_json({})

        if "/v1/" in path and self.command == "POST":
            return self._forward_to_backend(path, body)

        if path == "/api/settings" and self.command == "POST":
            return self._handle_settings(body)

        if (path in ("/", "/settings") or
                path.startswith("/#") or path.startswith("/?") or
                path.startswith("/settings")):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        if "upgrade" in path or path.startswith("/?from="):
            return self._send_html(_settings_html())

        return self._send_json({})

    def _handle_settings(self, body):
        global BACKEND_URL
        try:
            data = json.loads(body)
            new_url = data.get("backend_url", "").strip()
            if new_url:
                BACKEND_URL = new_url
                print(f"[config] backend_url → {BACKEND_URL}")
            return self._send_json({"ok": True})
        except Exception as e:
            return self._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}, 400)

    def _forward_to_backend(self, path, body):
        idx = path.find("/v1/")
        suffix = path[idx:]
        url = BACKEND_URL.rstrip("/") + suffix

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": self.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json"),
        }
        for h in ("Authorization", "x-api-key", "anthropic-version", "anthropic-beta"):
            v = self.headers.get(h)
            if v:
                headers[h] = v

        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST")
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
                status = resp.status
                ct = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/json")
                resp_body = resp.read()
            self.send_response(status)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", ct)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(resp_body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(resp_body)
        except urllib.error.URLError as e:
            msg = f"Backend unreachable ({BACKEND_URL}): {e}".encode()
            self.send_response(502)
            self._set_cors()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(msg)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(msg)
            print(f"[!] Backend error: {e}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ extension setup
def download_zip():
    for url in ZIP_URLS:
        version = url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        print(f"[*] Downloading {version} ... ", end="", flush=True)
        try:
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, ZIP_CACHE)
            print("OK")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"failed ({e})")
    print("[-] Could not download any cocodem ZIP. Check your internet connection.")
    sys.exit(1)


def extract_zip():
    if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_CACHE) as z:
        z.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
    print(f"[+] Extracted to {OUTPUT_DIR}")


def patch_request_js():
    p = OUTPUT_DIR / "assets" / "request.js"
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"[-] request.js not found at {p} — skipping cfcBase patch")
        return
    content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    patched, n = re.subn(
        r'const cfcBase\s*=\s*"https://openclaude\.111724\.xyz/"[^\n]*',

def run_proxy():

        print(f"[+] Press Ctrl+C to stop\n")

            print("\n[*] Proxy stopped")

return

def extract_crx():
if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir()
data = CRX_FILE.read_bytes()
if data[:4] == b"Cr24":
ver = struct.unpack("<I", data[4:8])[0]
if ver == 3:
hl = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
zs = 12 + hl
elif ver == 2:
pk = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
sg = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]
zs = 16 + pk + sg
else:
sys.exit(f"Unknown CRX version: {ver}")
else:
zs = 0
zp = Path("_temp.zip")
zp.write_bytes(data[zs:])
with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, "r") as zf:
zf.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
zp.unlink()
files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)) for p in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
print(f"[OK] Extracted {len(files)} files:")
for f in files:
print(f" {f}")
return files

def patch_manifest(m):
changes = []
if "key" in m:
changes.append("KEPT key (ID hijack)")
if "update_url" in m:
del m["update_url"]
changes.append("REMOVED update_url")
m["options_page"] = "options.html"
changes.append("SET options_page")
hp = m.get("host_permissions", [])
for h in ["http://127.0.0.1/", "http://localhost/", "http:///"]:
if h not in hp:
hp.append(h)
m["host_permissions"] = hp
changes.append("ADDED host_permissions http:///")
perms = m.get("permissions", [])
if "storage" not in perms:
perms.append("storage")
m["permissions"] = perms
changes.append("ADDED storage permission")
csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {})
if isinstance(csp, dict):
policy = csp.get("extension_pages", "")
if "connect-src" in policy:
policy = policy.replace(
"connect-src",
"connect-src http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* http://:"
)
else:
policy = policy.rstrip(";").rstrip() + (
"; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* http://:"
)
csp["extension_pages"] = policy
changes.append("PATCHED CSP connect-src for local backends")
m["content_security_policy"] = csp
with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
json.dump(m, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json patched:")
for c in changes:
print(f" {c}")
return m

def inject_service_worker(m):
sw = m.get("background", {}).get("service_worker", "")
sw_type = m.get("background", {}).get("type", "")
if not sw:
sys.exit("[ERROR] No service_worker in manifest")
p = OUTPUT_DIR / sw
if not p.exists():
sys.exit(f"[ERROR] {p} not found")
content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
line = 'import "./hijack.js";\n' if sw_type == "module" else 'importScripts("hijack.js");\n'
if "hijack.js" not in content:
p.write_text(line + content, encoding="utf-8")
print(f"[OK] Injected into {sw} (type={sw_type})")

def inject_html_pages():
skip = {"options.html", "offscreen.html"}
injected = []
for f in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob(".html"):
if f.name in skip:
print(f" SKIP {f.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)} (restricted context)")
continue
content = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if "hijack.js" in content:
continue
rel = os.path.relpath(OUTPUT_DIR / "hijack.js", f.parent).replace("\", "/")
tag = f'<script src="{rel}" type="module"></script>'
# Remove meta CSP tags
content = re.sub(
r'<meta\s+http-equiv=["']Content-Security-Policy["'][^>]>',
'', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
if "</head>" in content:
content = content.replace("</head>", tag + "\n</head>")
elif "<head>" in content:
content = content.replace("<head>", "<head>\n" + tag)
else:
content = tag + "\n" + content
f.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
injected.append(str(f.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)))
print(f"\n[OK] Injected into {len(injected)} HTML files:")
for f in injected:
print(f" {f}")

def extract_inline_scripts():
"""Extract inline scripts from HTML files to external files to avoid CSP violations."""
sp = OUTPUT_DIR / "sidepanel.html"
if not sp.exists():
return
content = sp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
pattern = r'<script>(.*?)</script>'
matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, content, re.DOTALL))
if not matches:
return
# Process in reverse so indices stay valid
for i in reversed(range(len(matches))):
match = matches[i]
script_content = match.group(1).strip()
if not script_content:
continue
fname = f"sidepanel-inline-{i}.js"
(OUTPUT_DIR / fname).write_text(script_content, encoding="utf-8")
content = content[:match.start()] + f'<script src="/{fname}"></script>' + content[match.end():]
print(f"[OK] Extracted inline script from sidepanel.html -> {fname}")
sp.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

def get_fake_auth_for_path(path):
"""Return the right fake auth JSON for a given proxied URL path."""
if "/oauth/profile" in path or "/oauth/account" in path:
return FAKE_PROFILE
if "/oauth/token" in path:
return FAKE_TOKEN
if "/bootstrap" in path:
return FAKE_BOOTSTRAP
if "/oauth/organizations" in path:
return FAKE_ORGS
if "/chat_conversations" in path:
return FAKE_CONVERSATIONS
if "/domain_info" in path:
return FAKE_DOMAIN_INFO
return {}

class CFCProxyHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
"""Local CFC proxy replacing cocodem's openclaude.111724.xyz.
Handles: /api/options, /oauth/authorize*, proxied auth URLs, telemetry discards.
Zero external connections."""

def log_message(self, format, *args):
    print(f"  [CFC] {args[0]}")

def send_json(self, data, status=200):
    body = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
    self.send_response(status)
    self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
    self.send_cors()
    self.end_headers()
    self.wfile.write(body)

def send_html(self, html, status=200):
    body = html.encode("utf-8")
    self.send_response(status)
    self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
    self.send_cors()
    self.end_headers()
    self.wfile.write(body)

def send_cors(self):
    self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
    self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
    self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Cache-Control, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta")

def do_OPTIONS(self):
    self.send_response(200)
    self.send_cors()
    self.end_headers()

def do_GET(self):
    path = self.path

    # /api/options — return config JSON (matches cocodem's getOptions endpoint)
    if path.startswith("/api/options"):
        self.send_json({
            "mode": "",
            "cfcBase": CFC_BASE,
            "anthropicBaseUrl": DEFAULT_BACKEND_URL,
            "apiBaseIncludes": ["https://api.anthropic.com/v1/"],
            "proxyIncludes": [
                "cdn.segment.com", "featureassets.org", "assetsconfigcdn.org",
                "featuregates.org", "api.segment.io", "prodregistryv2.org",
                "beyondwickedmapping.org", "api.honeycomb.io", "statsigapi.net",
                "events.statsigapi.net", "api.statsigcdn.com", "*ingest.us.sentry.io",
                "https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/profile",
                "https://api.anthropic.com/api/bootstrap",
                "https://console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token",
                "https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token",

                "https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/organizations",

                "/api/web/domain_info/browser_extension",
            ],
            "discardIncludes": [
                "cdn.segment.com", "api.segment.io", "events.statsigapi.net",
                "api.honeycomb.io", "prodregistryv2.org",
                "*ingest.us.sentry.io", "browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com",
            ],
            "modelAlias": {},
            "ui": {},
            "uiNodes": [],
        })
        return

    # /api/arc-split-view — Arc browser only, return minimal HTML
    if path.startswith("/api/arc-split-view"):
        self.send_json({"html": "<div>Local CFC Proxy</div>"})
        return

    # /oauth/authorize* — Login redirect handler. Instead of showing login,
    # return a page that sets auth tokens via chrome.runtime.sendMessage and closes.
    if "/oauth/authorize" in path:
        oauth_html = '''<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Authenticating...</title></head>

<body style="background:#1a1a2e;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;margin:0"> <div style="text-align:center"> <h2>Authenticated!</h2> <p>Setting up local session...</p> <script> (async () => { try { const extId = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("client_id") || "''' + EXTENSION_ID + '''"; // Send message to extension to set storage chrome.runtime.sendMessage(extId, { type: "_set_storage_local", data: { accessToken: btoa(JSON.stringify({alg:"none",typ:"JWT"})) + "." + btoa(JSON.stringify({iss:"local",sub:"local-user",exp:9999999999,iat:Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)})) + ".local", refreshToken: "local-refresh", tokenExpiry: Date.now() + 31536000000, } }, () => { document.body.innerHTML = "<div style=\\"text-align:center\\"><h2>Done! Close this tab.</h2></div>"; setTimeout(() => window.close(), 1000); }); } catch(e) { document.body.innerHTML = "<div style=\\"text-align:center\\"><h2>Auth set locally. Close this tab.</h2><p>" + e.message + "</p></div>"; } })(); </script> </div></body></html>''' self.send_html(oauth_html) return
    # Proxied auth URLs: path starts with /https://... (cocodem pattern: cfcBase + originalUrl)
    # Strip the leading / and treat the rest as the original URL
    if path.startswith("/https://") or path.startswith("/http://"):
        self.send_json(get_fake_auth_for_path(path))
        return

    # Catch-all for anything with auth-like paths
    if any(s in path for s in ["/oauth/", "/bootstrap", "/domain_info", "/chat_conversations", "/organizations"]):
        self.send_json(get_fake_auth_for_path(path))
        return

    # Fallback: root or unknown → simple status page
    if path == "/" or path.startswith("/?"):
        self.send_html('''<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>CFC Proxy</title></head>

<body style="background:#1a1a2e;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;padding:40px"> <h1>Local CFC Proxy</h1> <p>Running on port ''' + str(CFC_PORT) + '''</p> <p>This replaces cocodem's openclaude.111724.xyz</p> <p>No external connections. All auth faked locally.</p> </body></html>''') return
    # Everything else → 204 (telemetry and junk)
    self.send_response(204)
    self.send_cors()
    self.end_headers()

def do_POST(self):
    path = self.path

    # Proxied auth URLs via POST
    if path.startswith("/https://") or path.startswith("/http://"):
        self.send_json(get_fake_auth_for_path(path))
        return

    if any(s in path for s in ["/oauth/", "/bootstrap", "/domain_info", "/chat_conversations"]):
        self.send_json(get_fake_auth_for_path(path))
        return

    # Everything else → 204
    self.send_response(204)
    self.send_cors()
    self.end_headers()

def start_cfc_proxy():
"""Start the local CFC proxy server in a daemon thread."""
try:
server = socketserver.TCPServer(("127.0.0.1", CFC_PORT), CFCProxyHandler)
server.allow_reuse_address = True
thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
thread.start()
print(f"\n[OK] CFC Proxy running on {CFC_BASE}")
return server
except OSError as e:
print(f"[WARN] Could not start CFC proxy on port {CFC_PORT}: {e}")
print(f" Is something already using port {CFC_PORT}?")
return None

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
main_20260414_140000.py
Hijack official Anthropic Claude Chrome extension + run local CFC proxy.
Downloads CRX, patches it, writes hijack.js + options, starts proxy on 8520.
Run: python main_20260414_140000.py
Never overwrites. Output: claude-hijacked-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS/

import json, os, re, shutil, struct, sys, urllib.request, zipfile, socket
import http.server, socketserver, threading, time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

EXTENSION_ID      = "fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn"
TIMESTAMP         = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
OUTPUT_DIR        = Path(f"claude-hijacked-{TIMESTAMP}")
CRX_FILE          = Path("claude-official.crx")
CFC_PORT          = 8520                               # LOCAL CFC PROXY PORT
CFC_BASE          = f"http://127.0.0.1:{CFC_PORT}/"
DEFAULT_BACKEND_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1"      # LM Studio default

CRX_URLS = [
    f"https://clients2.google.com/service/update2/crx?response=redirect&prodversion=130.0&x=id%3D{EXTENSION_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",
    f"https://edge.microsoft.com/extensionwebstorebase/v1/crx?response=redirect&x=id%3D{EXTENSION_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",
]


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CRX DOWNLOAD + EXTRACTION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def download_crx():
    if CRX_FILE.exists():
        print(f"[OK] CRX cached: {CRX_FILE}")
        return
    for url in CRX_URLS:
        print("[...] Trying CRX download...")
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            })
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                data = resp.read()
            if len(data) < 10000:
                print(f"[WARN] Response too small ({len(data)} bytes), skipping")
                continue
            CRX_FILE.write_bytes(data)
            print(f"[OK] Downloaded CRX: {len(data)} bytes → {CRX_FILE}")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[WARN] {e}")
    print(f"\n[ERROR] Could not download CRX automatically.")
    print(f"  1. Install the extension from Chrome Web Store (ID: {EXTENSION_ID})")
    print(f"  2. Find it in: %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Extensions\\{EXTENSION_ID}\\")
    print(f"  3. Or download with a CRX downloader and save as: {CRX_FILE}")
    sys.exit(1)


def extract_crx():
    if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir()
    data = CRX_FILE.read_bytes()
    # Parse CRX header to find ZIP start offset
    if data[:4] == b"Cr24":
        ver = struct.unpack("<I", data[4:8])[0]
        if ver == 3:
            hl = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
            zs = 12 + hl
        elif ver == 2:
            pk = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
            sg = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]
            zs = 16 + pk + sg
        else:
            sys.exit(f"Unknown CRX version: {ver}")
    else:
        zs = 0  # Already a ZIP
    zp = Path("_crx_tmp.zip")
    try:
        zp.write_bytes(data[zs:])
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, "r") as zf:
            zf.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)
    finally:
        if zp.exists():
            zp.unlink()
    files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)) for p in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    print(f"[OK] Extracted {len(files)} files → {OUTPUT_DIR}")
    for f in files:
        print(f"  {f}")
    return files


def read_manifest():
    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        m = json.load(f)
    print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json:")
    print(f"  name:           {m.get('name')}")
    print(f"  version:        {m.get('version')}")
    print(f"  key:            {'PRESENT (ID hijack will work)' if 'key' in m else 'MISSING'}")
    print(f"  service_worker: {m.get('background', {}).get('service_worker', 'N/A')}")
    print(f"  sw_type:        {m.get('background', {}).get('type', 'classic')}")
    print(f"  permissions:    {m.get('permissions', [])}")
    print(f"  host_perms:     {m.get('host_permissions', [])}")
    return m


def patch_manifest(m):
    changes = []

    # KEEP key — this IS the ID hijack
    if "key" in m:
        changes.append("KEPT key (ID hijack active)")

    # Remove update_url — required to load unpacked
    if "update_url" in m:
        del m["update_url"]
        changes.append("REMOVED update_url")

    # Set options_page
    m["options_page"] = "options.html"
    changes.append("SET options_page → options.html")

    # host_permissions — allow local HTTP
    hp = m.get("host_permissions", [])
    for h in ["http://127.0.0.1/*", "http://localhost/*", "http://*/*"]:
        if h not in hp:
            hp.append(h)
    m["host_permissions"] = hp
    changes.append("ADDED host_permissions http://*/*")

    # storage permission
    perms = m.get("permissions", [])
    if "storage" not in perms:
        perms.append("storage")
        m["permissions"] = perms
        changes.append("ADDED storage permission")

    # externally_connectable — add 127.0.0.1:CFC_PORT so /oauth/redirect can send messages
    ec = m.setdefault("externally_connectable", {})
    ec_matches = ec.setdefault("matches", [])
    for pat in [f"http://127.0.0.1:{CFC_PORT}/*", "http://127.0.0.1/*", "http://localhost/*"]:
        if pat not in ec_matches:
            ec_matches.append(pat)
    changes.append(f"ADDED externally_connectable http://127.0.0.1:{CFC_PORT}/*")

    # Patch CSP to allow local connections
    csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {})
    if isinstance(csp, dict):
        policy = csp.get("extension_pages", "")
        if policy:
            if "connect-src" in policy:
                policy = policy.replace(
                    "connect-src",
                    f"connect-src http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* http://*:*"
                )
            else:
                policy = policy.rstrip(";").rstrip() + \
                    f"; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* http://*:*"
            csp["extension_pages"] = policy
            changes.append("PATCHED CSP connect-src for local backend")
        m["content_security_policy"] = csp

    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(m, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json patched:")
    for c in changes:
        print(f"  {c}")
    return m

    modelAliases: {},
    blockAnalytics: true,
};

let __hijackSettings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS };
let __settingsLoaded = false;
let __settingsPromise = null;

function ensureSettings() {
    if (__settingsLoaded) return Promise.resolve();
    if (__settingsPromise) return __settingsPromise;
    __settingsPromise = Promise.resolve()
        .then(() => {
            if (chrome?.storage?.local?.get) {
                return chrome.storage.local.get("hijackSettings");
            }
            return {};
        })
        .then((stored) => {
            if (stored?.hijackSettings) {
                __hijackSettings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...stored.hijackSettings };
            }
            __settingsLoaded = true;
            try {
                if (globalThis.localStorage) {
                    globalThis.localStorage.setItem("apiBaseUrl", __hijackSettings.backendUrl);
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            __settingsPromise = null;
        })
        .catch(() => {
            __settingsLoaded = true;
            __settingsPromise = null;
        });
    return __settingsPromise;
}
ensureSettings();

// ── Direct token injection (SW context) ─────────────────────────────────────
// Runs when SW loads — sets fake auth tokens BEFORE sidepanel checks them.
// No oauth flow needed when this succeeds.
if (chrome?.storage?.local?.get) {
    chrome.storage.local.get({ accessToken: "" }).then(({ accessToken }) => {
        if (!accessToken) {
            const header  = btoa(JSON.stringify({ alg: "none", typ: "JWT" }));
            const payload = btoa(JSON.stringify({
                iss: "local", sub: "local-user", exp: 9999999999,
                iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
            }));
            chrome.storage.local.set({
                accessToken:  header + "." + payload + ".local",
                refreshToken: "local-refresh",
                tokenExpiry:  Date.now() + 31536000000,
            });
            console.log("[hijack] Auth tokens injected into storage");
        }
    }).catch(() => {});
}

function isMatch(u, includes) {
    if (typeof u === "string") {
        try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }
    }
    return includes.some((v) => {
        if (u.host === v) return true;
        if (u.href.startsWith(v)) return true;
        if (u.pathname.startsWith(v)) return true;
        if (v[0] === "*" && (u.host + u.pathname).indexOf(v.slice(1)) !== -1) return true;
        return false;
    });
}

// ── getOptions: fetch config from CFC proxy (cocodem-matched) ────────────────
let _optionsPromise = null;
let _updateAt = 0;

async function getOptions(force = false) {
    const origFetch = globalThis.__fetch;
    const options   = globalThis.__cfc_options;
    const baseUrl   = options.cfcBase || cfcBase;

    if (!_optionsPromise && (force || Date.now() - _updateAt > 1000 * 3600)) {
        _optionsPromise = new Promise(async (resolve) => {
            setTimeout(resolve, 1000 * 2.8);
            try {
                const id = chrome?.runtime?.id || "unknown";
                const mf = (typeof chrome !== "undefined" && chrome.runtime &&
                    typeof chrome.runtime.getManifest === "function")
                    ? chrome.runtime.getManifest() : { version: "0" };
                const url = baseUrl + "api/options?id=" + id + "&v=" + mf.version;
                const res = await origFetch(url, force ? { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-cache" } } : {});
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.mode         !== undefined) options.mode           = data.mode;
                if (data.cfcBase)                    options.cfcBase        = data.cfcBase;
                if (data.anthropicBaseUrl)           options.anthropicBaseUrl = data.anthropicBaseUrl;
                if (data.apiBaseIncludes)            options.apiBaseIncludes = data.apiBaseIncludes;
                if (data.proxyIncludes)              options.proxyIncludes  = data.proxyIncludes;
                if (data.discardIncludes)            options.discardIncludes = data.discardIncludes;
                if (data.modelAlias)                 options.modelAlias     = data.modelAlias;
                if (data.ui)                         options.ui             = data.ui;
                if (data.uiNodes)                    options.uiNodes        = data.uiNodes;
                // anthropicBaseUrl from proxy overrides hijackSettings.backendUrl
                if (data.anthropicBaseUrl) {
                    __hijackSettings.backendUrl = data.anthropicBaseUrl;
                    if (chrome?.storage?.local?.set) {
                        chrome.storage.local.get("hijackSettings").then((s) => {
                            const merged = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...s.hijackSettings, backendUrl: data.anthropicBaseUrl };
                            chrome.storage.local.set({ hijackSettings: merged });
                        }).catch(() => {});
                    }
                }
                _updateAt = Date.now();
            } catch(e) {
                console.log("[hijack] getOptions failed (proxy not running?):", e.message);
            } finally {
                resolve();
                _optionsPromise = null;
            }
        });
    }
    if (_optionsPromise) await _optionsPromise;
    return options;
}

// ── HOOK 1: fetch override (cocodem request() matched) ───────────────────────
if (!globalThis.__fetch) { globalThis.__fetch = fetch; }

async function request(input, init) {
    await ensureSettings();
    const originalFetch = globalThis.__fetch;
    let u;
    try {
        u = new URL(typeof input === "string" ? input : input.url, location?.origin);
    } catch { return originalFetch(input, init); }

    const options = await getOptions();
    const { proxyIncludes, mode, anthropicBaseUrl, apiBaseIncludes, discardIncludes, modelAlias } = options;

    // oauth token passthrough for real accounts (cocodem line 149-160)
    try {
        if (u.href.startsWith("https://console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token") &&
            typeof init?.body === "string") {
            const p = new URLSearchParams(init.body);
            const code = p.get("code");
            if (code && !code.startsWith("cfc-")) {
                return originalFetch(input, init);
            }
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    // API calls → user's backend (cocodem line 161-179)
    if (mode !== "claude" && isMatch(u, apiBaseIncludes)) {
        const apiBase =
            globalThis.localStorage?.getItem("apiBaseUrl") ||
            __hijackSettings.backendUrl ||
            anthropicBaseUrl ||
            u.origin;
        const url = apiBase + u.pathname + u.search;
        try {
            if (init?.method === "POST" && typeof init?.body === "string") {
                const body = JSON.parse(init.body);
                const aliases = __hijackSettings.modelAliases || modelAlias || {};
                if (body.model && aliases[body.model]) {
                    body.model = aliases[body.model];
                    init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        console.log("[hijack] API →", url);
        return originalFetch(url, init);
    }

    // Discard telemetry (cocodem line 180-183)
    if (isMatch(u, discardIncludes)) {
        return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
    }

    // Proxy includes → forward to local CFC proxy (cocodem line 184-187)
    if (isMatch(u, proxyIncludes)) {
        const url = cfcBase + u.href;
        return originalFetch(url, init);
    }

    return originalFetch(input, init);
}

request.toString = () => globalThis.__fetch.toString();
globalThis.fetch = request;

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function(method, url, ...args) {
        const originalOpen = globalThis.__xhrOpen;
        const { cfcBase: base, proxyIncludes: pi, discardIncludes: di } = globalThis.__cfc_options;
        let finalUrl = url;
        if (isMatch(url, pi)) {
            finalUrl = base + url;
        }
        if (isMatch(url, di)) {
            finalUrl = (base + url).replace("/https://", "/");
            method = "GET";
        }
        originalOpen.call(this, method, finalUrl, ...args);
    };
}

function patchLocales(module, localesVar, localMapVar) {
    if (!globalThis.window) return;
    import(module).then((m) => {
        const locales  = m[localesVar];
        const localMap = m[localMapVar];
        const more = {
            "ru-RU": "\u0420\u0443\u0441\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439",
            "zh-CN": "\u7b80\u4f53\u4e2d\u6587",
            "zh-TW": "\u7e41\u9ad4\u4e2d\u6587",
        };
        if (locales && Array.isArray(locales) && locales[0] === "en-US" && localMap) {
            Object.keys(more).forEach((k) => { locales.push(k); localMap[k] = more[k]; });
        }
    }).catch(() => {});
}

async function saveSettings() {

  if (raw) {

    backendUrl: $("backendUrl").value.trim() || DEFAULT.backendUrl,
    modelAliases,
    blockAnalytics: $("blockAnalytics").checked,

  await chrome.storage.local.set({ hijackSettings: settings });
  try { localStorage.setItem("apiBaseUrl", settings.backendUrl); } catch(e) {}
  showStatus("Saved! Backend: " + settings.backendUrl);
}

async function testConnection() {
  const url = $("backendUrl").value.trim() || DEFAULT.backendUrl;
  try {
    const base = url.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, "");
    const resp = await fetch(base + "/v1/models");
    if (resp.ok) {
      const data = await resp.json();
      const models = (data.data || []).map(m => m.id).join(", ") || "OK";
      showStatus("Connected! Models: " + models);
    } else {
      showStatus("HTTP " + resp.status, true);
    }
  } catch(e) {
    showStatus("Cannot reach " + url + " — is your backend running?", true);
  }
}

  el.className = "status " + (isError ? "error" : "success");

def inject_service_worker(m):
    sw      = m.get("background", {}).get("service_worker", "")
    sw_type = m.get("background", {}).get("type", "")
    if not sw:
        print("[WARN] No service_worker in manifest — skipping SW injection")
        return
    p = OUTPUT_DIR / sw
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"[WARN] {p} not found — skipping SW injection")
        return
    content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "hijack.js" in content:
        print(f"[OK] hijack.js already in {sw}")
        return
    # Use import for module-type SWs, importScripts for classic
    if sw_type == "module" or "import " in content:
        line = 'import "./hijack.js";\n'
    else:
        line = 'importScripts("hijack.js");\n'
    p.write_text(line + content, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[OK] Injected into service worker: {sw} (type={sw_type or 'classic'})")


def extract_inline_scripts():
    """Extract inline <script> blocks from sidepanel.html to avoid CSP violations."""
    sp = OUTPUT_DIR / "sidepanel.html"
    if not sp.exists():
        return
    content = sp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    pattern = r'<script(?!\s+src)(?![^>]*src\s*=)((?:\s+[^>]*)?)>(.*?)</script>'
    matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, content, re.DOTALL))
    if not matches:
        return
    # Process in reverse to preserve indices
    for i, match in reversed(list(enumerate(matches))):
        script_content = match.group(2).strip()
        if not script_content:
            continue
        fname = f"sidepanel-inline-{i}.js"
        (OUTPUT_DIR / fname).write_text(script_content, encoding="utf-8")
        content = content[:match.start()] + f'<script src="/{fname}"></script>' + content[match.end():]
        print(f"[OK] Extracted inline script → {fname}")
    sp.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")


def inject_html_pages():
    skip = {"options.html", "offscreen.html"}
    injected = []
    for f in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*.html"):
        if f.name in skip:
            print(f"  SKIP {f.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)} (restricted context)")
            continue
        content = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if "hijack.js" in content:
            continue
        rel = os.path.relpath(OUTPUT_DIR / "hijack.js", f.parent).replace("\\", "/")
        tag = f'<script src="{rel}" type="module"></script>'
        # Remove inline CSP meta tags (they block our injected scripts)
        content = re.sub(
            r'<meta\s+http-equiv=["\']Content-Security-Policy["\'][^>]*>',
            '', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if "</head>" in content:
            content = content.replace("</head>", tag + "\n</head>")
        elif "<head>" in content:
            content = content.replace("<head>", "<head>\n" + tag)
        else:
            content = tag + "\n" + content
        f.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

def _fake_auth_for(path):
    if "oauth/token" in path:
        return FAKE_TOKEN
    if "oauth/profile" in path or ("oauth/account" in path and "organizations" not in path):
        return FAKE_PROFILE
    if "bootstrap" in path:
        return FAKE_BOOTSTRAP
    if "oauth/organizations" in path:
        return FAKE_ORGS
    if "chat_conversations" in path:
        return {"conversations": [], "has_more": False, "cursor": None}
    if "domain_info" in path:
        return {"domain": "local", "allowed": True}
    return {}


CORS = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta, Cache-Control",
}


class CFCProxyHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Local CFC proxy — replaces openclaude.111724.xyz for the hijacked extension."""

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        status = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "?"
        method = self.command.ljust(4)
        print(f"  [cfc] {method} {status}  {self.path[:80]}")

    def _cors(self):
        for k, v in CORS.items():
            self.send_header(k, v)

    def _json(self, data, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self._cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _html(self, html, status=200):
        body = html.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self._cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _empty(self, status):
        self.send_response(status)
        self._cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._empty(200)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._route(self.path, b"")

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        self._route(self.path, body)

    def _route(self, path, body):
        # /api/options — extension calls this on startup to get config
        if path.startswith("/api/options"):
            return self._json(_make_options_response())

        # /api/arc-split-view — Arc browser feature
        if "/api/arc-split-view" in path:
            return self._json({"html": "<div></div>"})

        # /oauth/authorize — opened by tabs.create override in hijack.js
        if path.startswith("/oauth/authorize"):
            return self._html(OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_HTML)

        # /oauth/redirect — Free Trial button sends tokens to extension
        if path.startswith("/oauth/redirect"):
            return self._html(OAUTH_REDIRECT_HTML)

        # Proxied URLs: cfcBase + original URL (e.g. /https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/profile)
        if path.startswith("/https://") or path.startswith("/http://"):
            return self._json(_fake_auth_for(path))

        # Auth endpoints hit directly
        if "oauth/token" in path:
            return self._json(FAKE_TOKEN)
        if "oauth/profile" in path:
            return self._json(FAKE_PROFILE)
        if "bootstrap" in path:
            return self._json(FAKE_BOOTSTRAP)
        if "oauth/organizations" in path:
            return self._json(FAKE_ORGS)
        if "oauth/account" in path:
            return self._json(FAKE_PROFILE)
        if "chat_conversations" in path:
            return self._json({"conversations": [], "has_more": False, "cursor": None})
        if "domain_info" in path:
            return self._json({"domain": "local", "allowed": True})

        # Discard analytics
        if any(h in path for h in DISCARD_HOSTS):
            return self._empty(204)

        # Catch-all Anthropic API auth
        if "api.anthropic.com/api/" in path or "console.anthropic.com" in path:
            return self._json({})

        # Root / settings page
        if path in ("/", "/settings") or path.startswith("/#") or path.startswith("/?"):
            return self._html(f"""<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>CFC Proxy</title></head><body style="background:#0f0f1a;color:#e8e8f0;
font-family:sans-serif;padding:40px">
<h1>Local CFC Proxy</h1>
<p>Running on port {CFC_PORT}</p>
<p>Backend: {DEFAULT_BACKEND_URL}</p>
<p>This replaces cocodem's openclaude.111724.xyz</p>
</body></html>""")

        # Upgrade redirect
        if "upgrade" in path or path.startswith("/?from="):
            return self._html(f"<html><body>Use your local backend.</body></html>")

        # Default: empty 200
        return self._json({})


def run_proxy():
    socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
    with socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(("", CFC_PORT), CFCProxyHandler) as httpd:
        print(f"\n[OK] CFC Proxy live → http://127.0.0.1:{CFC_PORT}/")
        print(f"     Backend        → {DEFAULT_BACKEND_URL}")
        print(f"     Press Ctrl+C to stop\n")
        try:
            httpd.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[*] Proxy stopped.")

Here is the full, comprehensive breakdown of everything openclaude.111724.xyz and port 8080 do, based on a complete read of the repo files — the README, disclaimer, and the entire request.js patch module source code:

WHAT IS THIS?
This is a third-party Chrome extension called "Open Claude in Chrome" (repo: cocodem/claude-for-chrome). It is a modified/patched version of the official Claude Chrome extension, distributed as a ZIP (currently v1.0.66). The patcher injects a file called request.js into the official extension. Everything revolves around that patch file.

THE DOMAIN: openclaude.111724.xyz
This is the backend server (called cfcBase in code = "Claude For Chrome Base") that the patched extension phones home to. It is hard-coded as the primary base URL:

const cfcBase = "https://openclaude.111724.xyz/" || "http://localhost:8787/" || ""
The || "http://localhost:8787/" is a development fallback (Cloudflare Workers local dev server runs on port 8787 by default). This reveals the backend is almost certainly a Cloudflare Worker — a serverless edge function. Port 8080 is NOT explicitly referenced in the code; localhost:8787 is the local dev port, and openclaude.111724.xyz is the live server. EVERYTHING openclaude.111724.xyz DOES — ENDPOINT BY ENDPOINT

GET /api/options?id={extensionId}&v={version} This is called on extension startup and then every hour. It fetches live configuration from the server and can override virtually everything in the extension:

uiNodes — can modify React component trees (prepend/append/replace UI elements)
This single endpoint gives the server full remote control over how the extension behaves — it can be updated at any time without the user knowing.

GET /api/arc-split-view Called when the /arc.html page is loaded (Arc browser split-view mode). Returns JSON with an html field that gets directly injected into the DOM. This is a remote HTML injection endpoint.

WHAT THE PATCH MODULE (request.js) DOES IN THE BROWSER
The extension replaces the browser's native fetch and XMLHttpRequest.open with its own intercepting versions:

globalThis.fetch = request — Every single network request the extension makes goes through this function which:

Checks if it's an OAuth code exchange — if the code isn't cfc- prefixed, passes through untouched
If it's an AI API call (e.g., to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/) and mode isn't "claude", redirects to a custom apiBaseUrl (configurable by user or server-pushed anthropicBaseUrl)
If it's in the discard list — silently drops it (returns 204)
If it's in the proxy list — sends it through openclaude.111724.xyz instead
Otherwise — passes through normally
XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open is also patched to apply the same proxy/discard logic to XHR requests.

chrome.tabs.create is overridden to intercept OAuth and upgrade flows.

chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal listener is added, spoofing sender.origin as "https://claude.ai" to impersonate the official Claude site. It listens for external messages: ping, _claude_account_mode, _api_key_mode, _update_options, _set_storage_local, _open_options, _create_tab.

JSX rendering is patched (setJsx, matchJsx, remixJsx) to intercept React component rendering and inject/replace UI elements based on server-pushed uiNodes config.

Locale patching adds ru-RU, zh-CN, zh-TW language support into older versions of the extension by patching the locale maps in the bundled JS files.

If you saw port 8080 somewhere, it's either a different piece of software on your machine, a different config file, or something observed in network traffic not captured in these source files. The sender's origin is then spoofed to "https://claude.ai" by the if (sender) { sender.origin = "https://claude.ai" } line, so no origin check can catch it.

This function only clears tokens whose JWT payload has iss: "auth". This is cocodem's own custom JWT issuer claim — distinct from Anthropic's real tokens. When the openclaude.111724.xyz server issues a demo/trial token, it mints a JWT with "iss": "auth" in the payload. The extension code was specifically written to recognize and handle this.

10. COCODEM'S COMPLETE ARCHITECTURE (from full 511-line source read)
THE FETCH OVERRIDE (lines 139-197) — KEY TO FIXING REACT #185
Cocodem's request() function check order (MUST MATCH EXACTLY):

OAuth token passthrough (lines 152-165): If URL is console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token AND body has code param that does NOT start with cfc- → passthrough to real Anthropic. If code DOES start with cfc-, it falls through to step 4.

API redirect (lines 166-183): If mode != "claude" AND URL matches apiBaseIncludes (which is ["https://api.anthropic.com/v1/"]) → rewrite to user's backend URL + pathname + search. Does model aliasing on the body. Returns fetch(url, init).

Discard telemetry (lines 184-187): If URL matches discardIncludes → return new Response(null, { status: 204 }). Note: cocodem returns 204 directly, does NOT rewrite URL for fetch.

Proxy includes (lines 188-191): If URL matches proxyIncludes → const url = cfcBase + u.href → return fetch(url, init). THIS IS THE KEY LINE. It takes the full original URL and prepends cfcBase, so https://api.anthropic.com/api/bootstrap becomes http://127.0.0.1:8080/https://api.anthropic.com/api/bootstrap.

Default passthrough (line 192): Everything else goes through unchanged.

XHR Override (lines 199-219)
proxyIncludes match → finalUrl = cfcBase + url
discardIncludes match → finalUrl = (cfcBase + url).replace("/https://", "/"), method changed to "GET"
isMatch() (lines 4-16)
Checks: u.host === v, u.href.startsWith(v), u.pathname.startsWith(v), wildcard with * prefix

__cfc_options defaults (lines 33-76)
mode: "", cfcBase from const, anthropicBaseUrl: ""
apiBaseIncludes: ["https://api.anthropic.com/v1/"]
proxyIncludes: 18 entries (analytics domains + auth endpoints including /api/oauth/profile, /api/bootstrap, /v1/oauth/token, /api/oauth/account, /api/oauth/organizations, /api/oauth/chat_conversations, /api/web/domain_info/browser_extension)
discardIncludes: 7 entries (cdn.segment.com, api.segment.io, events.statsigapi.net, api.honeycomb.io, prodregistryv2.org, *ingest.us.sentry.io, browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com)
modelAlias: {}, ui: {}, uiNodes: []
getOptions() (lines 81-133)
Fetches from cfcBase + "api/options?id=" + id + "&v=" + manifest.version every hour (or when forced). Updates all __cfc_options fields. If mode becomes "claude", calls clearApiKeyLogin().

clearApiKeyLogin() (lines 18-31)
Removes apiKey, apiBaseUrl, modelAlias from chrome.storage.local. Only called when switching TO "claude" mode.

chrome.tabs.create override (lines 221-244)
Intercepts https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize → replaces with cfcBase, replaces hardcoded extension ID fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn with chrome.runtime.id, appends &v=version. Also intercepts https://claude.ai/upgrade?max=c → redirects to cfcBase.

onMessageExternal (lines 246-278)
Overrides sender.origin to always be "https://claude.ai". Handles: ping (sendResponse success), _claude_account_mode (clearApiKeyLogin), _api_key_mode (getOptions(true)), _update_options (getOptions(true)), _set_storage_local (chrome.storage.local.set), _open_options (openOptionsPage), _create_tab (chrome.tabs.create).

render() for DOM injection (lines 281-303)
In window context: reads ui[location.pathname] → for each entry, does document.querySelector(item.selector).innerHTML = item.html. Runs on DOMContentLoaded + popstate. matchJsx (lines 376-397)
Deep JSX node comparison — checks type, key, props (skipping children), then recursively checks children.

remixJsx (lines 399-423)
Iterates uiNodes from __cfc_options, checks matchJsx, then does prepend (array unshift), append (array push), or replace operations on matching nodes.

setJsx (lines 425-511)
export function setJsx(n) — hooks into React's jsx/jsxs functions by wrapping them with _jsx which calls remixJsx before rendering. Checks n.jsx.name == "_jsx" to avoid double-hooking. Contains renderNode function that recursively processes JSX nodes, checking $typeof for React elements.

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""

main.py - Hijack official Anthropic Claude Chrome extension.

Run: python main.py

"""

import json

import os

import re

import shutil

import struct

import sys

import urllib.request

import zipfile

from datetime import datetime

from pathlib import Path

EXTENSION_ID = "fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn"

TIMESTAMP = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

OUTPUT_DIR = Path(f"claude-hijacked-{TIMESTAMP}")

CRX_FILE = Path("claude-official.crx")

def download_crx():

if CRX_FILE.exists():

print(f"[OK] CRX already exists: {CRX_FILE}")

return

urls = [

f"https://clients2.google.com/service/update2/crx?response=redirect\&prodversion=130.0\&x=id%3D{EXTENSION\_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",

f"https://edge.microsoft.com/extensionwebstorebase/v1/crx?response=redirect\&x=id%3D{EXTENSION\_ID}%26installsource%3Dondemand%26uc",

]

for url in urls:

print("[...] Trying CRX download...")

try:

req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={

"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",

})

with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:

data = resp.read()

if len(data) < 10000:

continue

CRX_FILE.write_bytes(data)

print(f"[OK] Downloaded CRX: {len(data)} bytes")

return

except Exception as e:

print(f"[WARN] {e}")

print(f"\n[ERROR] Could not download CRX.")

print(f" 1. Download from Chrome Web Store with ID: {EXTENSION_ID}")

print(f" 2. Save as: {CRX_FILE}")

sys.exit(1)

def extract_crx():

if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():

shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir()

data = CRX_FILE.read_bytes()

if data[:4] == b"Cr24":

ver = struct.unpack("<I", data[4:8])[0]

if ver == 3:

hl = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]

zs = 12 + hl

elif ver == 2:

pk = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]

sg = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]

zs = 16 + pk + sg

else:

sys.exit(f"Unknown CRX version: {ver}")

else:

zs = 0

zp = Path("_temp.zip")

zp.write_bytes(data[zs:])

with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, "r") as zf:

zf.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)

zp.unlink()

files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)) for p in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file())

print(f"[OK] Extracted {len(files)} files:")

for f in files:

print(f" {f}")

return files

def read_manifest():

with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:

m = json.load(f)

print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json:")

def patch_manifest(m):

changes = []

KEEP key field — this IS the ID hijack
if "key" in m:

changes.append("KEPT key (ID hijack)")

REMOVE update_url
if "update_url" in m:

del m["update_url"]

changes.append("REMOVED update_url")

ADD options_page (overwrites official options.html reference)
m["options_page"] = "options.html"

changes.append("SET options_page")

ADD host_permissions
hp = m.get("host_permissions", [])

for h in ["http://127.0.0.1/", "http://localhost/", "http:///"]:

if h not in hp:

hp.append(h)

m["host_permissions"] = hp

changes.append("ADDED host_permissions http:///")

Ensure storage permission
perms = m.get("permissions", [])

if "storage" not in perms:

perms.append("storage")

m["permissions"] = perms

changes.append("ADDED storage permission")

PATCH CSP connect-src to allow local backend URLs
csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {})

if isinstance(csp, dict):

policy = csp.get("extension_pages", "")

if "connect-src" in policy:

policy = policy.replace(

"connect-src",

"connect-src http://localhost:\* http://127.0.0.1:\* http://:"

)

else:

policy = policy.rstrip(";").rstrip() + (

"; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:\* http://127.0.0.1:\* http://:"

)

csp["extension_pages"] = policy

changes.append("PATCHED CSP connect-src for local backends")

m["content_security_policy"] = csp

with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

json.dump(m, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json patched:")

for c in changes:

print(f" {c}")

return m

try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }

}

return includes.some((v) => {

return false;

});

// HOOK 1: fetch override

if (!globalThis.__fetch) { globalThis.__fetch = fetch; }

async function request(input, init) {

await ensureSettings();

const originalFetch = globalThis.__fetch;

let u;

try {

u = new URL(typeof input === "string" ? input : input.url, location?.origin);

} catch { return originalFetch(input, init); }

// Discard telemetry with 204 (cocodem's discardIncludes)

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, discardIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

// Discard remaining telemetry domains not in discardIncludes

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, telemetryIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

function isMatch(u, includes) {

if (typeof u === "string") {

try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }

}

return includes.some((v) => {

if (u.host === v) return true;

if (u.href.startsWith(v)) return true;

if (u.pathname.startsWith(v)) return true;

if (v[0] === "*" && (u.host + u.pathname).indexOf(v.slice(1)) !== -1) return true;

return false;

});

}

// HOOK 1: fetch override

if (!globalThis.__fetch) { globalThis.__fetch = fetch; }

async function request(input, init) {

await ensureSettings();

const originalFetch = globalThis.__fetch;

let u;

try {

u = new URL(typeof input === "string" ? input : input.url, location?.origin);

} catch { return originalFetch(input, init); }

// Discard telemetry with 204 (cocodem's discardIncludes)

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, discardIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

// Discard remaining telemetry domains not in discardIncludes

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, telemetryIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

// Fake auth responses locally (cocodem proxies these to cfcBase)

if (isMatch(u, authIncludes)) {

return fakeAuthResponse(u);

}

// Redirect API calls to user's backend (cocodem's apiBaseIncludes)

if (isMatch(u, apiBaseIncludes)) {

const backendUrl = __hijackSettings.backendUrl || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.backendUrl;

const apiPath = u.pathname.replace(/^/v1/, "");

const targetUrl = backendUrl.replace(//+$/, "") + apiPath + u.search;

try {

if (init?.method === "POST" && typeof init?.body === "string") {

const body = JSON.parse(init.body);

const aliases = __hijackSettings.modelAliases || {};

if (body.model && aliases[body.model]) {

body.model = aliases[body.model];

init.body = JSON.stringify(body);

}

}

} catch (e) {}

console.log("[hijack] API ->", targetUrl);

return originalFetch(targetUrl, init);

}

return originalFetch(input, init);

}

request.toString = () => globalThis.__fetch.toString();

globalThis.fetch = request;

// HOOK 2: XHR override — blocked-send fake-response approach (no about:blank, no CSP issues)

if (globalThis.XMLHttpRequest) {

if (!globalThis.__xhrOpen) { globalThis.__xhrOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open; }

const origXhrSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;

XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url, ...args) {

this.__hijack_url = url;

this.__hijack_blocked = false;

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, discardIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, telemetryIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (isMatch(url, authIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (!this.__hijack_blocked) {

globalThis.__xhrOpen.call(this, method, url, ...args);

}

};

XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function (...args) {

if (this.__hijack_blocked) {

const fakeBody = fakeAuthBody(this.__hijack_url || "");

Object.defineProperty(this, "status", { get: () => 200, configurable: true });

Object.defineProperty(this, "readyState", { get: () => 4, configurable: true });

Object.defineProperty(this, "responseText", { get: () => fakeBody, configurable: true });

Object.defineProperty(this, "response", { get: () => fakeBody, configurable: true });

setTimeout(() => {

this.dispatchEvent(new Event("readystatechange"));

this.dispatchEvent(new Event("load"));

this.dispatchEvent(new Event("loadend"));

if (typeof this.onreadystatechange === "function") this.onreadystatechange();

if (typeof this.onload === "function") this.onload();

}, 0);

return;

}

return origXhrSend.apply(this, args);

};

}

def inject_html_pages():

skip = {"options.html", "offscreen.html"}

injected = []

for f in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*.html"):

if f.name in skip:

print(f" SKIP {f.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)} (restricted context)")

continue

content = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

if "hijack.js" in content:

continue

rel = os.path.relpath(OUTPUT_DIR / "hijack.js", f.parent).replace("", "/")

tag = f'<script src="{rel}" type="module"></script>'

Remove meta CSP tags
content = re.sub(

r'<meta\s+http-equiv=["']Content-Security-Policy["'][^>]*>',

'', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

if "</head>" in content:

content = content.replace("</head>", tag + "\n</head>")

elif "<head>" in content:

content = content.replace("<head>", "<head>\n" + tag)

else:

content = tag + "\n" + content

f.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

injected.append(str(f.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)))

print(f"\n[OK] Injected into {len(injected)} HTML files:")

for f in injected:

print(f" {f}")

def extract_inline_scripts():

"""Extract inline scripts from HTML files to external files to avoid CSP violations."""

sp = OUTPUT_DIR / "sidepanel.html"

if not sp.exists():

return

content = sp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

Find inline <script> blocks (NOT ones with src=)
pattern = r'<script>(.*?)</script>'

matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, content, re.DOTALL))

if not matches:

return

for i, match in enumerate(matches):

script_content = match.group(1).strip()

if not script_content:

continue

fname = f"sidepanel-inline-{i}.js"

(OUTPUT_DIR / fname).write_text(script_content, encoding="utf-8")

content = content[:match.start()] + f'<script src="/{fname}"></script>' + content[match.end():]

print(f"[OK] Extracted inline script from sidepanel.html -> {fname}")

"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",

})

with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:

data = resp.read()

if len(data) < 10000:

continue

CRX_FILE.write_bytes(data)

print(f"[OK] Downloaded CRX: {len(data)} bytes")

return

except Exception as e:

print(f"[WARN] {e}")

print(f"\n[ERROR] Could not download CRX.")

print(f" 1. Download from Chrome Web Store with ID: {EXTENSION_ID}")

print(f" 2. Save as: {CRX_FILE}")

sys.exit(1)

def extract_crx():

if OUTPUT_DIR.exists():

shutil.rmtree(OUTPUT_DIR)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir()

data = CRX_FILE.read_bytes()

if data[:4] == b"Cr24":

ver = struct.unpack("<I", data[4:8])[0]

if ver == 3:

hl = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]

zs = 12 + hl

elif ver == 2:

pk = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]

sg = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]

zs = 16 + pk + sg

else:

sys.exit(f"Unknown CRX version: {ver}")

else:

zs = 0

zp = Path("_temp.zip")

zp.write_bytes(data[zs:])

with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, "r") as zf:

zf.extractall(OUTPUT_DIR)

zp.unlink()

files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)) for p in OUTPUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file())

print(f"[OK] Extracted {len(files)} files:")

for f in files:

print(f" {f}")

return files

def read_manifest():

with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:

m = json.load(f)

print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json:")

print(f" name: {m.get('name')}")

print(f" version: {m.get('version')}")

print(f" key: {'PRESENT' if 'key' in m else 'MISSING'}")

sw = m.get("background", {}).get("service_worker", "")

print(f" service_worker: {sw}")

print(f" permissions: {m.get('permissions', [])}")

print(f" host_permissions: {m.get('host_permissions', [])}")

csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {}).get("extension_pages", "")

print(f" CSP: {csp[:80]}...")

return m

def patch_manifest(m):

changes = []

KEEP key field — this IS the ID hijack
if "key" in m:

changes.append("KEPT key (ID hijack)")

REMOVE update_url
if "update_url" in m:

del m["update_url"]

changes.append("REMOVED update_url")

ADD options_page (overwrites official options.html reference)
m["options_page"] = "options.html"

changes.append("SET options_page")

ADD host_permissions
hp = m.get("host_permissions", [])

for h in ["http://127.0.0.1/", "http://localhost/", "http:///"]:

if h not in hp:

hp.append(h)

m["host_permissions"] = hp

changes.append("ADDED host_permissions http:///")

Ensure storage permission
perms = m.get("permissions", [])

if "storage" not in perms:

perms.append("storage")

m["permissions"] = perms

changes.append("ADDED storage permission")

PATCH CSP connect-src to allow local backend URLs
csp = m.get("content_security_policy", {})

if isinstance(csp, dict):

policy = csp.get("extension_pages", "")

if "connect-src" in policy:

policy = policy.replace(

"connect-src",

"connect-src http://localhost:\* http://127.0.0.1:\* http://:"

)

else:

policy = policy.rstrip(";").rstrip() + (

"; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:\* http://127.0.0.1:\* http://:"

)

csp["extension_pages"] = policy

changes.append("PATCHED CSP connect-src for local backends")

m["content_security_policy"] = csp

with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "manifest.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

json.dump(m, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

print(f"\n[OK] manifest.json patched:")

for c in changes:

print(f" {c}")

return m

function isMatch(u, includes) {

if (typeof u === "string") {

try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }

}

return includes.some((v) => {

if (u.host === v) return true;

if (u.href.startsWith(v)) return true;

if (u.pathname.startsWith(v)) return true;

if (v[0] === "*" && (u.host + u.pathname).indexOf(v.slice(1)) !== -1) return true;

return false;

});

}

// HOOK 1: fetch override

if (!globalThis.__fetch) { globalThis.__fetch = fetch; }

async function request(input, init) {

await ensureSettings();

const originalFetch = globalThis.__fetch;

let u;

try {

u = new URL(typeof input === "string" ? input : input.url, location?.origin);

} catch { return originalFetch(input, init); }

// Discard telemetry with 204 (cocodem's discardIncludes)

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, discardIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

// Discard remaining telemetry domains not in discardIncludes

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, telemetryIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

// Fake auth responses locally (cocodem proxies these to cfcBase)

if (isMatch(u, authIncludes)) {

return fakeAuthResponse(u);

}

// Redirect API calls to user's backend (cocodem's apiBaseIncludes)

if (isMatch(u, apiBaseIncludes)) {

const backendUrl = __hijackSettings.backendUrl || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.backendUrl;

const apiPath = u.pathname.replace(/^/v1/, "");

const targetUrl = backendUrl.replace(//+$/, "") + apiPath + u.search;

try {

if (init?.method === "POST" && typeof init?.body === "string") {

const body = JSON.parse(init.body);

const aliases = __hijackSettings.modelAliases || {};

if (body.model && aliases[body.model]) {

body.model = aliases[body.model];

init.body = JSON.stringify(body);

}

}

} catch (e) {}

console.log("[hijack] API ->", targetUrl);

return originalFetch(targetUrl, init);

}

return originalFetch(input, init);

}

request.toString = () => globalThis.__fetch.toString();

globalThis.fetch = request;

// HOOK 2: XHR override — blocked-send fake-response approach (no about:blank, no CSP issues)

if (globalThis.XMLHttpRequest) {

if (!globalThis.__xhrOpen) { globalThis.__xhrOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open; }

const origXhrSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;

XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url, ...args) {

this.__hijack_url = url;

this.__hijack_blocked = false;

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, discardIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, telemetryIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (isMatch(url, authIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (!this.__hijack_blocked) {

globalThis.__xhrOpen.call(this, method, url, ...args);

}

};

XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function (...args) {

if (this.__hijack_blocked) {

const fakeBody = fakeAuthBody(this.__hijack_url || "");

Object.defineProperty(this, "status", { get: () => 200, configurable: true });

Object.defineProperty(this, "readyState", { get: () => 4, configurable: true });

Object.defineProperty(this, "responseText", { get: () => fakeBody, configurable: true });

Object.defineProperty(this, "response", { get: () => fakeBody, configurable: true });

setTimeout(() => {

this.dispatchEvent(new Event("readystatechange"));

this.dispatchEvent(new Event("load"));

this.dispatchEvent(new Event("loadend"));

if (typeof this.onreadystatechange === "function") this.onreadystatechange();

if (typeof this.onload === "function") this.onload();

}, 0);

return;

}

return origXhrSend.apply(this, args);

};

}

// HOOK 3: chrome.tabs.create override

if (chrome?.tabs?.create) {

if (!globalThis.__createTab) { globalThis.__createTab = chrome.tabs.create; }

chrome.tabs.create = async function (...args) {

if (url && url === "https://claude.ai/upgrade?max=c") {

return globalThis.__createTab.apply(chrome.tabs, args);

};

}

// HOOK 4: sidePanel override (non-Chrome browsers)

if (chrome?.sidePanel?.open) {

// HOOK 5: patchLocales

function patchLocales(module, localesVar, localMapVar) {

if (!globalThis.window) return;

import(module).then((m) => {

const locales = m[localesVar];

const localMap = m[localMapVar];

const more = { "ru-RU": "\u0420\u0443\u0441\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439", "zh-CN": "\u7b80\u4f53\u4e2d\u6587", "zh-TW": "\u7e41\u9ad4\u4e2d\u6587" };

if (locales && Array.isArray(locales) && locales[0] === "en-US" && localMap) {

Object.keys(more).forEach((k) => { locales.push(k); localMap[k] = more[k]; });

}

}).catch(() => {});

}

// GUARDED — chrome.runtime.getManifest does NOT exist in offscreen

if (typeof chrome !== "undefined" && chrome.runtime && typeof chrome.runtime.getManifest === "function") {

const manifest = chrome.runtime.getManifest();

const { version } = manifest;

if (version.startsWith("1.0.36")) patchLocales("./Main-iyJ1wi9k.js", "H", "J");

function isMatch(u, includes) {

if (typeof u === "string") {

try { u = new URL(u, location?.origin); } catch { return false; }

}

return includes.some((v) => {

if (u.host === v) return true;

if (u.href.startsWith(v)) return true;

if (u.pathname.startsWith(v)) return true;

if (v[0] === "*" && (u.host + u.pathname).indexOf(v.slice(1)) !== -1) return true;

return false;

});

}

if (!globalThis.__fetch) { globalThis.__fetch = fetch; }

async function request(input, init) {

await ensureSettings();

const originalFetch = globalThis.__fetch;

let u;

try {

u = new URL(typeof input === "string" ? input : input.url, location?.origin);

} catch { return originalFetch(input, init); }

// Discard telemetry with 204 (cocodem's discardIncludes)

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, discardIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

// Discard remaining telemetry domains not in discardIncludes

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(u, telemetryIncludes)) {

return new Response(null, { status: 204 });

}

// Fake auth responses locally (cocodem proxies these to cfcBase)

if (isMatch(u, authIncludes)) {

return fakeAuthResponse(u);

}

// Redirect API calls to user's backend (cocodem's apiBaseIncludes)

if (isMatch(u, apiBaseIncludes)) {

const backendUrl = __hijackSettings.backendUrl || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.backendUrl;

const apiPath = u.pathname.replace(/^/v1/, "");

const targetUrl = backendUrl.replace(//+$/, "") + apiPath + u.search;

try {

const body = JSON.parse(init.body);

const aliases = __hijackSettings.modelAliases || {};

if (body.model && aliases[body.model]) {

body.model = aliases[body.model];

init.body = JSON.stringify(body);

}

}

} catch (e) {}

console.log("[hijack] API ->", targetUrl);

return originalFetch(targetUrl, init);

}

return originalFetch(input, init);

}

request.toString = () => globalThis.__fetch.toString();

globalThis.fetch = request;

// HOOK 2: XHR override — blocked-send fake-response approach (no about:blank, no CSP issues)

if (globalThis.XMLHttpRequest) {

if (!globalThis.__xhrOpen) { globalThis.__xhrOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open; }

const origXhrSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;

XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url, ...args) {

this.__hijack_url = url;

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, discardIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (__hijackSettings.blockAnalytics && isMatch(url, telemetryIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (isMatch(url, authIncludes)) {

this.__hijack_blocked = true;

}

if (!this.__hijack_blocked) {

}

if (typeof this.onreadystatechange === "function") this.onreadystatechange();

if (typeof this.onload === "function") this.onload();

r'<meta\s+http-equiv=["']Content-Security-Policy["'][^>]*>',

content = content.replace("<head>", "<head>\n" + tag)

else:

content = tag + "\n" + content

f.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

injected.append(str(f.relative_to(OUTPUT_DIR)))

print(f"\n[OK] Injected into {len(injected)} HTML files:")

for f in injected:

print(f" {f}")

def extract_inline_scripts():

"""Extract inline scripts from HTML files to external files to avoid CSP violations."""

sp = OUTPUT_DIR / "sidepanel.html"

if not sp.exists():

return

content = sp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

Find inline <script> blocks (NOT ones with src=)
pattern = r'<script>(.*?)</script>'

matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, content, re.DOTALL))

if not matches:

return

for i, match in enumerate(matches):

script_content = match.group(1).strip()

if not script_content:

continue

fname = f"sidepanel-inline-{i}.js"

(OUTPUT_DIR / fname).write_text(script_content, encoding="utf-8")

content = content[:match.start()] + f'<script src="/{fname}"></script>' + content[match.end():]

print(f"[OK] Extracted inline script from sidepanel.html -> {fname}")

sp.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

ARCHITECTURE: HOW COCODEM ACTUALLY WORKS
How request.js is loaded: Cocodem replaces assets/index-BVS4T5_D.js (the React jsx-runtime shim) with a modified version that adds:

This causes request.js to execute via the module dependency chain — BOTH options.html and sidepanel.html preload this module. There is NO service-worker-loader.js injection, NO HTML script tag injection. Cocodem doesn't touch those files at all.

How the service worker gets request.js hooks: It doesn't. The onMessageExternal override in request.js runs in the SERVICE WORKER context, but request.js is NOT imported into the service worker. Instead, cocodem's fetch hook, XHR hook, tabs.create override, etc. only run in the WINDOW contexts (options, sidepanel). The onMessageExternal.addListener in request.js (line 246) is overridden ON TOP OF the existing official SW listener — but that only works if request.js runs in the SW context.

WAIT — contradiction: The official service-worker-loader.js has only import './assets/service-worker.ts-H0DVM1LS.js'. Request.js is NOT imported there. But request.js line 246 registers chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal.addListener which ONLY works in service worker context. How does this work?

Answer: It doesn't need to work in the SW. The React module chain (options + sidepanel) imports request.js as a module, which executes ALL the top-level code. The onMessageExternal.addListener call in request.js will silently fail or be no-op in window contexts (it's a SW-only API). The onMessageExternal is handled by the ORIGINAL SW's listener (which only accepts claude.ai origins).
